enemy_1000_gopro.lore: A creature controlled by a Reunion recon squad. Monitoring equipment is strapped to its body. Due to their speed and evasiveness, they can easily slip through enemy defenses and cause heavy damage.

enemy_1000_gopro_2.description: A fast-moving creature controlled by a Reunion recon squad that is more dangerous than a normal Hound.

enemy_1002_nsabr.description: One of Reunion's basic melee soldiers.
enemy_1002_nsabr.lore: One of Reunion's basic melee soldiers. Equipped with illegally obtained weapons and armor, they wear masks to conceal their identities during operations.

enemy_1003_ncbow.description: One of Reunion's basic ranged soldiers, capable of attacking from long range.
enemy_1003_ncbow.lore: One of Reunion's basic ranged soldiers. Equipped with illegally obtained weapons and armor, they wear masks to conceal their identities during operations.

enemy_1003_ncbow_2.description: A more dangerous version of the Crossbowman, capable of attacking from long range.
enemy_1003_ncbow_2.lore: One of Reunion's senior ranged soldiers, more powerful than a normal Crossbowman. Equipped with illegally obtained weapons and armor, they wear masks to conceal their identities during operations.

enemy_1011_wizard.description: One of Reunion's basic casters, capable of attacking using long-ranged Arts.
enemy_1011_wizard.lore: One of Reunion's basic casters. These Infected casters tend to use their own Originium to power their Arts. Because they don't rely on staves, their attacks are more unpredictable and they cannot simply be disarmed.

enemy_1011_wizard_2.description: A more dangerous version of the Caster, capable of attacking using long-ranged Arts.
enemy_1011_wizard_2.lore: One of Reunion's senior Casters, more powerful than a normal Caster. These Infected casters tend to use their own Originium to power their Arts. Because they don't rely on staves, their attacks are more unpredictable and they cannot simply be disarmed.

enemy_1013_airdrp.description: A special melee unit that can attack from unexpected positions.
enemy_1013_airdrp.lore: One of Reunion's special melee soldiers. They are equipped with modified disposable jetpacks made from looted parts. Despite their fairly rudimentary equipment, Reunion uses them to great effect when attacking insufficiently protected areas.

abilities.text: Able to land directly onto the battlefield.

enemy_1013_airdrp_2.description: A special melee unit, more dangerous than a normal Airborne Soldier, that can attack from unexpected positions.
enemy_1013_airdrp_2.lore: One of Reunion's special melee soldiers, more dangerous than a normal Airborne Soldier. They are equipped with modified disposable jetpacks made from looted parts. Despite their fairly rudimentary equipment, Reunion uses them to great effect when attacking insufficiently protected areas.

abilities.text: Able to land directly onto the battlefield.

enemy_1024_mortar.description: A special ranged unit that can launch very long-ranged AoE attacks.
enemy_1024_mortar.lore: One of Reunion's special ranged soldiers. Equipped with pilfered military-grade Originium launchers, they launch explosive attacks from hard-to-defend positions, making them a significant threat to back-line Operators.

abilities.text: Capable of extremely long ranged-attacks
Shells deal area damage to target and any allied units in the surrounding 8 tiles

enemy_1024_mortar_2.description: A more dangerous Mortar Gunner that can launch very long-ranged AoE attacks.
enemy_1024_mortar_2.lore: One of Reunion's special ranged soldiers, more dangerous than a normal Mortar Gunner. Equipped with pilfered military-grade Originium launchers, they launch explosive attacks from hard-to-defend positions, making them a significant threat to back-line Operators.

abilities.text: Capable of extremely long ranged-attacks
Shells deal area damage to target and any allied units in the surrounding 8 tiles

enemy_1014_rogue.description: A Reunion melee soldier, known for having high attack damage.
enemy_1014_rogue.lore: One of Reunion's melee soldiers. Trained in dual-wielding, it is likely that these fighters once served in the military. Their combat expertise makes them harder to deal with than the average rioter.

enemy_1014_rogue_2.description: A more dangerous Dual Swordsman, known for having high attack damage.
enemy_1014_rogue_2.lore: One of Reunion's melee soldiers, more dangerous than a normal Dual-bladed Swordsman. Trained in dual-wielding, it is likely that these fighters once served in the military. Their combat expertise makes them harder to deal with than the average rioter.

enemy_1015_litamr.description: A Reunion melee soldier that has fairly high defense.
enemy_1015_litamr.lore: One of Reunion's melee soldiers. Equipped with illegally obtained weapons and armor, they are better equipped and trained, and cannot be taken down with conventional strategies.

enemy_1015_litamr_2.description: A more potent Light-Armored Soldier that has fairly high defense.
enemy_1015_litamr_2.lore: One of Reunion's melee soldiers, more dangerous than a normal Armored Soldier. Equipped with illegally obtained weapons and armor, they are better equipped and trained, and cannot be taken down with conventional strategies.

enemy_1016_diaman.description: An infected wild creature, completely covered in metal. Though most conventional weapons are not very effective against them, they aren't as heavy as they seem
enemy_1016_diaman.lore: An infected wild creature, completely covered in metal. Though most conventional weapons are not very effective against them, they aren't as heavy as they seem, and also move slowly. Due to their low intelligence, they are easily controlled by enemy casters for use as cannon fodder during invasions.

enemy_1009_lurker.description: One of Reunion's special soldiers, cannot be attacked unless blocked
enemy_1009_lurker.lore: One of Reunion's special soldiers. They move swiftly and stealthily, making it almost impossible to detect them before they engage in combat. Therefore, teamwork is needed in order to defeat them.

abilities.text: Invisible

enemy_1008_ghost.description: A Reunion engineer that cannot be blocked. Must be eliminated as quickly as possible.
enemy_1008_ghost.lore: One of Reunion's engineers. Though unarmed, they utilize their agility and cunning to slip through defenses in order to sabotage mechanical and electrical equipment.

abilities.text: Cannot be blocked.

enemy_1005_yokai.description: [Aerial Unit] An unmanned enemey drone that does not attack.
enemy_1005_yokai.lore: An unmanned enemy drone, called 'Monster' by Reunion forces. Equipped with a long-range Arts receiver, they are likely operated by concealed Casters. Though unlikely to cause heavy damage to armored Operators, they can still pose a considerable threat.

abilities.text: Flying unit.

enemy_1005_yokai_2.description: [Aerial Unit] An improved version of the Monster that can launch ranged attacks.
enemy_1005_yokai_2.lore: An unmanned enemy drone that has been upgraded from its namesake model, the Monster MkII. Equipped with a small gun and a long-range Arts receiver, they are likely operated by concealed Casters. Though unlikely to cause heavy damage to armored Operators, they can still pose a considerable threat.

abilities.text: Flying unit.

enemy_1005_yokai_3.description: [Aerial Unit] A larger, more resilient unmanned drone that can launch ranged attacks.
enemy_1005_yokai_3.lore: An unmanned enemy drone, its design and name seem to be inspired by a certain space game. Equipped with a minigun and a long-range Arts receiver, they are likely operated by concealed Casters. Their outstanding stealthiness and attack power pose a major threat to Operators.

abilities.text: Flying unit.

enemy_1017_defdrn.description: [Aerial Unit] A drone that can increase the DEF of allied units around them.
enemy_1017_defdrn.lore: An unmanned enemy drone known as the Defender-4. Though they do not have any offensive capabilities, they must be taken care of due to their ability to support enemy troops.

abilities.text: Flying unit.
Increases the DEF of surrounding enemy units

enemy_1019_jshoot.description: A ranged soldier that cannot be attacked unless blocked.
enemy_1019_jshoot.lore: One of Reunion's ranged soldiers. The ghillie suit they wear makes it almost impossible to detect them before they engage in combat. Therefore, teamwork is needed to defeat them.

abilities.text: Invisible

enemy_1019_jshoot_2.description: A stronger version of the Invisible Crossman that cannot be attacked unless blocked.
enemy_1019_jshoot_2.lore: One of Reunion's ranged soldiers, more dangerous than a normal Invisible Crossbowman. The ghillie suit they wear makes it almost impossible to detect them before they engage in combat. Therefore, teamwork is needed to defeat them.

abilities.text: Invisible

abilities.text: Invisible

enemy_1020_obsv.description: An engineer that is capable of detecting invisible allied Operators around them.
enemy_1020_obsv.lore: One of Reunion's engineers. They are able to utilize devices to assess the status of Operators and their equipment. Prioritize dealing with them.

abilities.text: Reveals invisible allied units in its surroundings

enemy_1026_aghost.description: A tougher Reunion engineer that boasts higher DEF and HP than a regular Wraith and cannot be blocked. Must be eliminated as quickly as possible.
enemy_1026_aghost.lore: One of Reunion's engineers. Due to being better trained and more heavily equipped, they are harder to neutralize in time, even if they have been detected. They utilize their agility and cunning to slip through defenses in order to sabotage mechanical and electrical equipment.

abilities.text: Cannot be blocked.

enemy_1027_mob.description: An enemy combatant of unknown identity, attacks using crude melee weapons.
enemy_1027_mob.lore: An enemy combatant of unknown identity. They are often found wherever there is turmoil and unrest. They wear a face mask to conceal their identity and use haphazardly-made weapons to engage in melee combat.

enemy_1027_mob_2.description: A more dangerous Rioter who attacks using crude melee weapons.
enemy_1027_mob_2.lore: An enemy combatant of unknown identity, more dangerous than a normal Thug. They are often found wherever there is turmoil and unrest. They wear a face mask to conceal their identity and use haphazardly-made weapons to engage in melee combat. These weapons are usually associated with riots.

enemy_1028_mocock.description: An enemy combatant of unknown identity who attacks using ranged Molotov cocktails.
enemy_1028_mocock.lore: An enemy combatant of unknown identity. They wear a face mask to conceal their identity, and use Molotov cocktails to deal damage within a range. These weapons are usually associated with riots.

enemy_1028_mocock_2.description: A more dangerous Cocktail Thrower who attacks using ranged Molotov cocktails.
enemy_1028_mocock_2.lore: An enemy combatant of unknown identity, more dangerous than a normal Cocktail Thrower. They wear a face mask to conceal their identity, and use Molotov cocktails to deal damage within a range.

enemy_1029_shdsbr.description: A Reunion melee soldier who has higher defensive abilities.
enemy_1029_shdsbr.lore: One of Reunion's melee soldiers. Equipped with illegally obtained weapons and armor, they additionally bear a shield. They are slightly harder to take down than a regular Reunion foot soldier.

enemy_1029_shdsbr_2.description: A more dangerous Shielded Soldier who has higher defensive abilities.
enemy_1029_shdsbr_2.lore: One of Reunion's melee soldiers, more dangerous than a normal Shielded Soldier. Equipped with illegally obtained weapons and armor, they additionally bear a shield. They are slightly harder to take down than a regular Reunion foot soldier.

enemy_1030_wteeth.lore: A ragged-looking enemy combatant. According to intel, they disguise themselves as drifters to conceal the fact that they are mercenaries. Though their background is unknown, their fierce attacks require them to be dealt with cautiously.

enemy_1030_wteeth_2.description: A ragged-looking enemy combatant. They have more combat experience than regular Junkmen.
enemy_1030_wteeth_2.lore: A ragged-looking enemy combatant with scars across their body, likely boasting more combat experience than a normal Junkman. According to intel, they disguise themselves as drifters to conceal the fact that they are mercenaries. Though their background is unknown, their fierce attacks require them to be dealt with cautiously.

enemy_1031_mrogue.description: One of Reunion's melee soldiers who also has been trained in using Originium Arts, capable of dealing Arts damage.
enemy_1031_mrogue.lore: One of Reunion's melee soldiers who has also been trained in using Originium Arts. They are able to enhance their melee attacks with armor-ignoring Arts damage. Reunion's frontline squads have become a lot more devastating since the inclusion of these soldiers.

enemy_1031_mrogue_2.description: A more dangerous Arts Guard with extensive experience in using Originium Arts, capable of dealing Arts damage.
enemy_1031_mrogue_2.lore: One of Reunion's melee soldiers who also has been trained in using Originium Arts, more dangerous than a normal Arts Guard. They are able to enhance their melee attacks with armor-ignoring Arts damage. Reunion's frontline squads have become a lot more devastating since the inclusion of these soldiers.

enemy_1032_katar.description: A Reunion melee soldier that has undergone combat training, boasting higher ATK and DEF.
enemy_1032_katar.lore: One of Reunion's melee soldiers who has been trained in traditional martial arts. Equipped with refitted fist weapons, they are capable of inflicting massive damage with their rapid strikes.

enemy_1032_katar_2.description: A more dangerous Bladed Fighter who has extensive combat training and boasts higher ATK and DEF.
enemy_1032_katar_2.lore: One of Reunion's melee soldiers who has been trained in traditional martial arts and is more dangerous than a normal Bladed Fighter. Equipped with refitted fist weapons, they are capable of inflicting massive damage with their rapid strikes.

enemy_1037_lunsbr.description: One of Reunion's melee soldiers. Their equipment differs slightly from that of other soldiers.
enemy_1037_lunsbr.lore: One of Reunion's melee soldiers. Their equipment differs slightly from that of other soldiers.

enemy_1038_lunmag.description: A Reunion caster equipped with armor that provides fairly high defense
enemy_1038_lunmag.lore: One of Reunion's Casters. Their armor makes them more resistant to physical damage compared to regular Casters.

enemy_1038_lunmag_2.description: An elite Reunion caster, more dangerous than a Spec Ops Caster, equipped with armor that provides fairly high defense. Attacks two targets simultaneously.
enemy_1038_lunmag_2.lore: One of Reunion's elite Casters. Their armor makes them more resistant to physical damage compared to regular Casters. They have mastered Arts that allows them to attack two targets at once. Proceed with caution.

abilities.text: Attacks two targets simultaneously.

enemy_1039_breakr.description: A well-trained Reunion rushing unit with high movement speed and above average ATK.
enemy_1039_breakr.lore: A well-trained enemy unit that spearheads assaults. Though their attack power is only slightly higher than average, their terrifying speed often allows them to break through the defenses of the unprepared- hence their nickname, 'Breakers.'

enemy_1039_breakr_2.description: A well-trained Reunion rushing unit, more dangerous than a normal Break, that has high movement speed and above average ATK.
enemy_1039_breakr_2.lore: A well-trained enemy unit that spearheads assaults, and is harder to defeat than a normal Breaker. Their attack power is higher than average, and their movement speed is incredibly high.

enemy_1041_lazerd.description: [Aerial Unit] A fast flying unit that can attack using ranged Arts.
enemy_1041_lazerd.lore: An unmanned enemy drone with extremely high movement speed, modified from the product of an Arts Education competition. It is equipped with an Arts Weapon module that allows it to launch long-range Arts attacks, so proceed with caution. Based on available data, its weapon module also allows it to block some Arts damage.

abilities.text: Flying unit.

enemy_1041_lazerd_2.description: [Aerial Unit] By trading off flight speed for power, they have a significantly stronger ranged Arts attack.
enemy_1041_lazerd_2.lore: An unmanned enemy drone that had some of its Flight Support modules swapped out, trading speed for a more powerful Arts Weapon module. Capable of using long-range Arts attacks. Proceed with caution. Based on available data, its weapon module also allows it to block some Arts damage.

abilities.text: Flying unit.

enemy_1043_zomsbr.description: A soldier that has been controlled by an unknown entity, capable of regenerating rapidly.
enemy_1043_zomsbr.lore: A soldier that has been controlled by an unknown entity, capable of regenerating rapidly. The appearance of such an aberration on the battlefield is almost beyond imagination.

abilities.text: Regenerates HP over time.

enemy_1043_zomsbr_2.description: A more dangerous Possessed Soldier that is capable of regenerating rapidly.
enemy_1043_zomsbr_2.lore: A soldier that has been controlled by an unknown entity, capable of regenerating rapidly and more dangerous than a normal Possessed Soldier. The appearance of such an aberration on the battlefield is almost beyond imagination.

abilities.text: Regenerates HP over time.

enemy_1044_zomstr.description: A Junkman that has been controlled by an unknown entity and is capable of regenerating rapidly.
enemy_1044_zomstr.lore: A Junkman that has been controlled by an unknown entity, capable of regenerating rapidly. Covered with clusters of Originium. The appearance of such an aberration on the battlefield is almost beyond imagination.

abilities.text: Regenerates HP over time.

enemy_1044_zomstr_2.description: A more dangerous Junkman that has been controlled by an unknown entity and is capable of regenerating rapidly.
enemy_1044_zomstr_2.lore: A Veteran Junkman that has been controlled by an unknown entity, capable of regenerating rapidly. Covered with clusters of Originium. The appearance of such an aberration on the battlefield is almost beyond imagination.

abilities.text: Regenerates HP over time.

enemy_1046_agent.description: A basic melee soldier. They are equipped with armor that can withstand some Arts damage.
enemy_1046_agent.lore: A basic melee soldier. Their armor provides some defense against Arts damage.

enemy_1046_agent_2.description: A basic melee soldier. They are stronger than normal Infantry.
enemy_1046_agent_2.lore: A basic melee soldier. They are stronger than normal Infantry.

enemy_1047_sagent.description: A basic ranged combatant that attacks from long distance. They can stun Operators after a few attacks.
enemy_1047_sagent.lore: A basic ranged soldier. They have very long range. Their sniper rifles can launch special ammunition capable of stunning our Operators.

abilities.text: After two attacks, the next attack Stuns its target

enemy_1047_sagent_2.description: An elite ranged combatant that attacks from long distance. They can inflict a long stun on Operators after a few attacks.
enemy_1047_sagent_2.lore: A basic ranged soldier. They are stronger than normal Snipers, firing improved ammunition that stuns for a longer duration. Proceed with caution.

abilities.text: After two attacks, the next attack Stuns its target

enemy_1051_norwiz.description: A basic caster soldier. Uses ranged Arts attacks.

enemy_1051_norwiz_2.description: A more dangerous Authorized Caster. Uses ranged Arts attacks.
enemy_1051_norwiz_2.lore: A basic caster soldier, more threatening than a normal Authorized Caster. Arts have been one of the most threatening forms of warfare since ancient times, and a large amount of research has gone into adapting Arts for contemporary warfare.

enemy_1052_noramr.description: A standard melee-range soldier. Their lightweight riot shields provide them both offensive and defensive flexibility.
enemy_1052_noramr.lore: A standard melee-range soldier. Their lightweight riot shields provide them both offensive and defensive flexibility. In battle, they pose a substantial threat to our front lines.

enemy_1052_noramr_2.description: A more dangerous version of the Shielded Guard. Their lightweight riot shields provide them both offensive and defensive flexibility.
enemy_1052_noramr_2.lore: A standard melee-range soldier. They are more dangerous than normal Shielded Guards Their lightweight riot shields provide them both offensive and defensive flexibility. In battle, they pose a substantial threat to our front lines.

enemy_1053_norgst.description: An engineer that specializes in sabotage. They move quickly and cannot be blocked. Must be eliminated as quickly as possible.
enemy_1053_norgst.lore: An engineer that specializes in sabotage, almost never seen wielding weapons. Though unarmed, they utilize their agility and cunning to slip through defenses in order to sabotage mechanical and electrical equipment.

abilities.text: Cannot be blocked.

enemy_1053_norgst_2.description: A more durable version of the Ergate. They move quickly and cannot be blocked. Must be eliminated as quickly as possible.
enemy_1053_norgst_2.lore: An engineer that specializes in sabotage, almost never seen wielding weapons. Though unarmed, they utilize their agility and cunning to slip through defenses in order to sabotage mechanical and electrical equipment. They are more difficult to deal with than normal Ergates.

abilities.text: Cannot be blocked.

enemy_1056_ganwar.lore: Combat personnel who have underwent special training. Their flurry of rapid blows are powerful enough to be fatal.

enemy_1056_ganwar_2.description: Exceptionally dangerous combatants who are even more destructive than normal Brawlers. Only the most heavily-armored Operators can withstand their blows.
enemy_1056_ganwar_2.lore: Exceptionally dangerous combatants who are even more destructive than normal Brawlers. Only the most heavily-armored Operators can withstand their blows.

enemy_1057_gansho.lore: Tactical long-range combatants. Adept at oppressing enemies with continuous fire, their tactical literacy means they will prefer targeting our command terminal in order to cut off support.

abilities.text: Shoots 3 times in a row

abilities.text: Attack power increases when attacking Frozen targets

At the same time, they can inflict fatal damage to frozen Operators, and must be dealt with cautiously.

abilities.text: Attack power increases when attacking Frozen targets

enemy_1065_snwolf_2.description: A dangerous, agile creature controlled by the Yeti Squadron, capable of dealing increased damage to Frozen units

At the same time, they can inflict fatal damage to frozen Operators, and must be dealt with cautiously.

abilities.text: Attack power increases when attacking Frozen targets

enemy_1066_snbow.description: A basic Yeti Squadron ranged combatant, capable of dealing increased damage to Frozen units
enemy_1066_snbow.lore: A basic ranged combatants of the Yeti Squadron hailing from teams of infected guerilla warriors in the Northwestern Tundra. Their synergy with other Yeti Squadron members make them pose an immense threat to frozen Operators.

abilities.text: Attack power increases when attacking Frozen targets

enemy_1066_snbow_2.description: An elite Yeti Squadron ranged combatant, capable of dealing increased damage to Frozen units
enemy_1066_snbow_2.lore: Senior ranged combatants of the Yeti Squadron hailing from teams of infected guerilla warriors in the Northwestern Tundra. Their richer combat experience and synergy with other Yeti Squadron members make them pose an immense threat to frozen Operators.

abilities.text: Attack power increases when attacking Frozen targets

enemy_1067_snslime.description: An infected wild creature native to colder environments that has become unstable due to assimilating a large amount of Originium into its abdomen. Upon death, they will explode, inflicting Cold on nearby Operators.
enemy_1067_snslime.lore: An infected wild creature native to colder environments that has become unstable due to assimilating a large amount of Originium into its abdomen. Upon death, they will explode and freeze nearby Operators. Due to their low intelligence, they are easily controlled by Yeti Squadron members for various tactical purposes.

abilities.text: Upon death, deals Physical damage in an area and applies Cold to affected targets

enemy_1067_snslime_2.description: A more threatening infected creature native to colder environments. Upon death, they will explode, inflicting Cold on nearby Operators.
enemy_1067_snslime_2.lore: An infected wild creature native to colder environments that has become unstable due to assimilating a large amount of Originium into its abdomen. More threatening than normal Infused Glacial Originium Slugs, they explode upon death, damaging and freezing nearby Operators. Due to their low intelligence, they are easily controlled by Yeti Squadron members for various tactical purposes.

abilities.text: Upon death, deals Physical damage in an area and applies Cold to affected targets

enemy_1068_snmage.description: A Yeti Squadron Caster, capable of inflicting Cold upon their targets after 2 attacks.
enemy_1068_snmage.lore: A basic caster of the Yeti Squadron hailing from teams of infected guerilla warriors in the Northwestern Tundra. Through special Arts and devices, they can inflict Cold on our Operators, reducing their attack speed and making them vulnerable to being Frozen.

abilities.text: After two attacks, the next attack applies the Cold effect

enemy_1068_snmage_2.description: An elite Yeti Squadron Caster, capable of inflicting Cold upon their targets after 2 attacks.
enemy_1068_snmage_2.lore: An elite caster of the Yeti Squadron hailing from teams of infected guerilla warriors in the Northwestern Tundra, boasting greater combat capabilities. Through special Arts and devices, they can inflict Cold on our Operators, reducing their attack speed and making them vulnerable to being Frozen.

abilities.text: After two attacks, the next attack applies the Cold effect

enemy_1071_dftman.description: A mercenary from Sarkaz who boasts fairly high RES.
enemy_1071_dftman.lore: A Sarkaz mercenary. Though scarred by years of war, they are still fighting to fulfill the orders of their employers.

enemy_1071_dftman_2.description: A more threatening Sarkaz Swordsman who boasts fairly high RES.
enemy_1071_dftman_2.lore: A Sarkaz mercenary, more skilled than an ordinary Sarkaz Swordsman. Though scarred by years of war, they are still fighting to fulfill the orders of their employers.

enemy_1073_dscout.description: Upon being injured, issues an alarm to improve the ATK and DEF of enemies as well as causing any enemy units in Standby to become Combat-Ready.
enemy_1073_dscout.lore: A Sarkaz mercenary. They are responsible for scouting, patrolling, and issuing early warnings to the entire squad. Once attacked, the Herald will immediately issue a warning that Inspires the entire army, shifting allied Sarkaz on Standby into Combat-Ready mode.

abilities.text: When injured, issues an alarm to immediately enhance the ATK and DEF of all enemy units, and makes enemies in Standby immediately enter Combat-Ready mode

enemy_1073_dscout_2.description: Upon being injured, issues an alarm to improve the ATK and DEF of enemies as well as causing any enemy units in Standby to become Combat-Ready.
enemy_1073_dscout_2.lore: A seasoned Sarkaz mercenary who has been through many battles. They are responsible for scouting, patrolling, and issuing early warnings to the entire squad. Once attacked, the Herald will immediately issue a warning that Inspires the entire army, shifting allied Sarkaz on Standby into Combat-Ready mode.

abilities.text: When injured, issues an alarm to immediately enhance the ATK and DEF of all enemy units, and makes enemies in Standby immediately enter Combat-Ready mode

enemy_1077_sotihd.description: A basic guerrilla-ops war hound equipped with lightweight Sarkaz armor, having decent defenses while still being able to move quickly.
enemy_1077_sotihd.lore: A basic guerrilla-ops war hound equipped with lightweight Sarkaz armor, having decent defenses while still being able to move quickly.

enemy_1077_sotihd_2.description: An elite guerrilla-ops war hound equipped with lightweight Sarkaz armor, more aggressive than standard Guerrilla Hounds.
enemy_1077_sotihd_2.lore: A better-trained warhound utilized by guerilla fighters. Sporting lightweight Ursus armor, they have a degree of defensive capabilities without sacrificing mobility, and are more aggressive than normal Guerilla Hounds.

enemy_1078_sotisc.description: Moves faster when Inspired by a Herald or by Patriot.
enemy_1078_sotisc.lore: A basic guerilla fighter. After receiving tactical commands, they will gain increased capabilities and utilize a full range of offensive maneuvers.

abilities.text: When Inspired, gains Movement Speed.

enemy_1078_sotisc_2.description: Moves faster when Inspired by a Herald or by Patriot.
enemy_1078_sotisc_2.lore: A veteran guerilla fighter. After receiving tactical commands, they will gain increased capabilities and utilize a full range of offensive maneuvers.

abilities.text: When Inspired, gains Movement Speed.

enemy_1079_sotisp.description: Attacks two targets at once when Inspired by a Herald or by Patriot.
enemy_1079_sotisp.lore: A basic guerilla sniper who has received professional, military-grade sharpshooting skills. After receiving tactical commands, they will gain increased capabilities and attack two targets at once.

abilities.text: When Inspired, attacks one additional target.

enemy_1079_sotisp_2.description: Attacks two targets at once when Inspired by a Herald or by Patriot.
enemy_1079_sotisp_2.lore: A veteran guerilla sniper who has extensive professional, military-grade sharpshooting skills. After receiving tactical commands, they will gain increased capabilities and attack two targets at once.

abilities.text: When Inspired, attacks one additional target.

enemy_1080_sotidp.description: When on the battlefield, Inspires all enemies, increasing their ATK and DEF.
enemy_1080_sotidp.lore: Patriot's guerilla fighters employ a special language to communicate and synergize their coordinated operations on the battlefield. The heralds are important links within their communication system. While present, they will issue tactical commands to increase the offensive and defensive abilities of nearby allies.

abilities.text: Increases the ATK and DEF of enemy units when on the battlefield.

enemy_1080_sotidp_2.description: When on the battlefield, Inspires all enemies, increasing their ATK and DEF.
enemy_1080_sotidp_2.lore: Compared to regular heralds, these leaders have greater individual combat capabilities. The heralds are important links within their communication system. While present, they will issue tactical commands to increase the offensive and defensive abilities of nearby allies.

abilities.text: Increases the ATK and DEF of enemy units when on the battlefield.

enemy_1086_ltsodr.description: More dangerous because of the widespread popularity of classical Originium Arts, their attacks inflict Arts damage.
enemy_1086_ltsodr.lore: One of Leithanien's radicalized locals. The widespread popularity of classical Originium Arts has made them more threatening, and their attacks inflict Arts damage.

enemy_1086_ltsodr_2.description: More dangerous because of the widespread popularity of classical Originium Arts, their attacks inflict even greater Arts damage.
enemy_1086_ltsodr_2.lore: One of Leithanien's local militia leaders. The widespread popularity of classical Originium Arts has made them more threatening, and their attacks inflict Arts damage.

enemy_1087_ltwolf.description: A hunting hound trained and harnessed by locals since ancient times. They once served as important partners for indigenous peoples and early pioneers.
enemy_1087_ltwolf.lore: A hunting hound trained and utilized by locals since ancient times. For early aboriginals and pioneers, these hounds were considered invaluable partners.

enemy_1087_ltwolf_2.description: A hunting hound trained and harnessed by locals since ancient times, designated as a pack leader. They once served as important partners for indigenous peoples and early pioneers.
enemy_1087_ltwolf_2.lore: A pack leader trained and utilized by locals since ancient times. For early aboriginals and pioneers, these hounds were considered invaluable partners.

enemy_1088_ltsmer.description: One of Leithanien's commonly seen Arts-wielders. Continuously casts at the nearest non-enemy controlled 'Gramophone,' and attempts to take control of it.
enemy_1088_ltsmer.lore: An Arts user commonly seen throughout Leithanien. They attack using Arts, and will cast on L-44 'Gramophones' within their attack range to attempt to seize control of them.

abilities.text: Continuously casts at the nearest non-enemy controlled 'Gramophone' within attack range to attempt to seize control of it.

enemy_1088_ltsmer_2.description: An experienced Leithanian Arts-wielder. Continuously casts at the nearest non-enemy controlled 'Gramophone,' and attempts to take control of it.
enemy_1088_ltsmer_2.lore: An experienced Leithanian combatant who utilizes Arts. Their Arts are more powerful, and they will cast on L-44 'Gramophones' within their attack range to attempt to seize control of them.

abilities.text: Continuously casts at the nearest non-enemy controlled 'Gramophone' within attack range to attempt to seize control of it.

enemy_1093_ccsbr.description: A commonly seen warrior of Acahualla; Gains DEF when blocked.
enemy_1093_ccsbr.lore: One of Acahualla's most commonly-seen warriors who uses a crude spear to attack. May pose unexpected difficulties if fighting at close range.

abilities.text: Gains DEF when blocked.

enemy_1093_ccsbr_2.description: A commonly seen warrior of Acahualla, more fierce than a normal Tiacauh Warrior; Gains DEF when blocked.
enemy_1093_ccsbr_2.lore: A braver, fiercer warrior who uses a crude spear to attack. Years of training have given these warriors tough physiques, and they fear not even the fiercest attacks.

abilities.text: Gains DEF when blocked.

enemy_1094_ccspm.description: Not much different from a Tiacauh Warrior, except having learned to use throwing weapons. Has short range but fast attack speed.
enemy_1094_ccspm.lore: Not much different from a regular warrior, except they've learned to throw their spears. Though their range is limited, they get the job done.

enemy_1094_ccspm_2.description: A fighter who is more experienced with throwing weapons after training. Has short range but fast attack speed.
enemy_1094_ccspm_2.lore: Warriors who have gained greater proficiency in using thrown weapons due to training, and boast greater lethality. However, due to the weight of their weapons, their range hasn't really improved.

enemy_1095_ccripr.description: A fervent Tiacauh combatant who thirsts for battle. Deals fast attacks, and each attack reduces the DEF of the target.
enemy_1095_ccripr.lore: A fervent Tiacauh warrior with very fast attack speed. Though each strike is not particularly powerful, those caught off guard will be quickly subdued by a rain of blows.

abilities.text: Every attack reduces the enemy's DEF

enemy_1095_ccripr_2.description: An extremely fervent Tiacauh combatant who thirsts for battle. Deals extremely fast attacks, and each attack reduces the DEF of the target.
enemy_1095_ccripr_2.lore: An extremely fervent Tiacauh warrior with very fast attack speed. Each strike now deals noteworthy damage, and those caught off guard will be quickly subdued by a rain of blows.

abilities.text: Every attack reduces the enemy's DEF

enemy_1096_ccwitch.description: One of Acahualla's rare Arts users. Inflicts Arts damage at long range and Physical damage at melee range.
enemy_1096_ccwitch.lore: The very few Originium Arts users in Acahualla will often serve as doctors for their tribe. Despite not developing their Originium Arts, their medical experience lets them strike where it hurts.

abilities.text: Gains DEF when blocked, and deals Physical damage with melee attacks.

enemy_1096_ccwitch_2.description: An Arts user who has been trained in Originium Arts. Inflicts Arts damage at long range and Physical damage at melee range.
enemy_1096_ccwitch_2.lore: These extremely rare Arts users from Acahualla have a deeper understanding of Originium Arts. With more threatening Arts in their arsenal and years of medical experience, they are a force to be reckoned with if allowed to approach up-close.

abilities.text: Gains DEF when blocked, and deals high Physical damage with melee attacks

enemy_1099_nbkght.description: An independent Kazimierz knight with little in the way of achievements or skill.
enemy_1099_nbkght.lore: An independent Kazimierz knight. A low profile and unrefined skill means this one will soon be swept away in the tide of knight competition.

enemy_1099_nbkght_2.description: An independent Kazimierz knight with slightly more accomplishments, but not by much.
enemy_1099_nbkght_2.lore: An independent Kazimierz knight with some degree of achievement, though not enough to inspire any confidence. Sooner or later, they'll probably get swallowed up by the competition.

enemy_1100_scorpn.description: An Infected creature commonly found in the lakes and rivers of Kazimierz.
enemy_1100_scorpn.lore: Infected creatures commonly found in the great lakes and rivers of Kazimierz, captured and raised by casters and used as tools to train knights and entertain fight spectators.

enemy_1100_scorpn_2.description: An Infected creature commonly found in the lakes and rivers of Kazimierz.
enemy_1100_scorpn_2.lore: Infected creatures commonly found in the great lakes and rivers of Kazimierz, these male gloompincers are fed special hormones and made more aggressive than the regular ones. They're a cruel tool to train knights and entertain fight spectators.

enemy_1101_plkght.description: Has significantly increased DEF and RES for a period of time.
enemy_1101_plkght.lore: Wearing the high-performance, lightweight armor provided by Roar Guards, this new batch of experimental armor has some humorous deficiencies that made these people into pitiful test subjects. 'Roar Guards, even the winds will bow to you!'

abilities.text: Has significantly increased DEF and RES for a period of time

enemy_1101_plkght_2.description: Has significantly increased DEF and RES for a period of time.
enemy_1101_plkght_2.lore: Wearing the high-performance, lightweight armor provided by Roar Guards, this new batch of experimental armor has some humorous deficiencies, and even though these are battle-hardened knights, they have still been reduced to pitiful test subjects. 'Roar Guards, even the winds will bow to you!'

abilities.text: Has significantly increased DEF and RES for a period of time

enemy_1101_plkght_3.description: Has significantly increased DEF and RES for a period of time.
enemy_1101_plkght_3.lore: The first member of Roar Knightclub's Majors team, now representative of Roar Arena: Tough armor, defensive counterattack, a hundred thousand fans, worth a million! Don't forget! 'Roar Guards, even the winds will bow to you!'

abilities.text: Starts with significantly increased DEF and RES, persists for a long period.

enemy_1105_tyokai.description: Ellen Select Technology Co. thanks you for your sponsorship! Knights, you're in for a Surprise if you manage to shoot one down!
enemy_1105_tyokai.lore: Ellen Select Technology thanks you for your sponsorship! This quick and affordable drone carries the passion of the fans, bringing anything to the knights on the field: traps, explosives, medicine, or even snacks! The outcome of the battle is in your hands!

abilities.text: Flying unit.
Does not count towards the defeated enemies counter
When destroyed, grants a deployable unit

enemy_1105_tyokai_2.description: Ellen Select Technology Co. thanks you for your sponsorship! Knights, you're in for a big Surprise if you manage to shoot one down!
enemy_1105_tyokai_2.lore: Ellen Select Technology thanks you for your generous sponsorship! This heavy and luxurious drone carries the passion of the fans, bringing anything to the knights on the field: devices, fincatching rods, or carbonated beverages! The outcome of the battle is in your hands!

abilities.text: Flying unit.
Does not count towards the defeated enemies counter
When destroyed, grants a large number of deployable units

enemy_1106_byokai.description: Ellen Select Technology Co. thanks you for your sponsorship! Knights, you'll enjoy greatly increased DEF and ASPD if you manage to shoot one down!
enemy_1106_byokai.lore: Ellen Select Technology thanks you for your heartfelt sponsorship! This drone broadcasts select commercials from the General Chamber of Commerce to knights and spectators at all times, stimulating the crowd and making the competition that much more exciting!

abilities.text: Flying unit.
Does not count towards the defeated enemies counter
Upon death, significantly increase ASPD and DEF of our units on the field for a period.

enemy_1107_uoffcr.description: Uses long-ranged weapons to attack Ursus Civilians and Talulah, the Fighter.
enemy_1107_uoffcr.lore: An officer tasked with hunting the Infected of Ursus. Greedy and cold-blooded.

abilities.text: Can use long-ranged weapons to attack Ursus Civilians and Talulah, the Fighter

enemy_1107_uoffcr_2.description: Uses long-ranged weapons to attack Ursus Civilians and Talulah, the Fighter.
enemy_1107_uoffcr_2.lore: A high-ranking officer tasked with hunting the Infected of Ursus. Greedy and cold-blooded. They are not a part of the army, and are generally despised by Ursus soldiers and city officials alike.

abilities.text: Can use long-ranged weapons to attack Ursus Civilians and Talulah, the Fighter

enemy_1108_uterer.description: A warbeast trained by the Ursus Army.
enemy_1108_uterer.lore: A warbeast trained by the Ursus Army. Obedient and relentless, they tear through armor with ease to sate their thirst for flesh and blood.

enemy_1108_uterer_2.description: A warbeast pack leader trained by the Ursus Army.
enemy_1108_uterer_2.lore: A warbeast pack leader trained by the Ursus Army. Obedient and relentless, they tear through armor with ease to sate their thirst for flesh and blood. Nobody has ever seen a male mangler.

enemy_1109_uabone.description: A combatant equipped with a powerful heavy-duty crossbow.
enemy_1109_uabone.lore: An Ursus soldier who is proficient at infiltrating deep into enemy territory. Equipped with a powerful heavy-duty crossbow.

abilities.text: Able to land directly onto the battlefield.

enemy_1109_uabone_2.description: A combatant equipped with an extremely powerful heavy-duty crossbow.
enemy_1109_uabone_2.lore: An Ursus soldier who is exceptionally proficient at infiltrating deep into enemy territory. Equipped with an extremely powerful heavy-duty crossbow.

abilities.text: Able to land directly onto the battlefield.

enemy_1110_uamord.description: A basic caster in the Ursus Army.
enemy_1110_uamord.lore: A basic caster in the Ursus Army. Clad in simple armor.

enemy_1110_uamord_2.description: A basic caster in the Ursus Army who has displayed excellence.
enemy_1110_uamord_2.lore: A basic caster in the Ursus Army who has displayed excellence. They are clad in armor and wield more powerful Arts.

enemy_3001_upeopl.description: Friendly Unit: does not deplete Life Points when spared, but will instead deduct 1 Life Point upon dying; Does not count towards the defeated enemies counter.
enemy_3001_upeopl.lore: An ordinary Ursus citizen caught in the crossfire. A part of the cruelty and suffering of this world.

abilities.text: Does not deplete Life Points when spared, but will deplete a Life Point upon dying
Does not count towards the defeated enemies counter

enemy_1116_liprr.description: A commonly-seen inmate in the Mansfield State Prison. After being freed, gains increased ATK.
enemy_1116_liprr.lore: A commonly seen prisoner of Mansfield State Prison. Even so, don't let your guard down or he'll slip past you.

abilities.text: Starts imprisoned. When imprisoned, ASPD is reduced
Freed after a few attacks, gaining increased ATK

enemy_1116_liprr_2.description: An inmate well-versed in the Mansfield State Prison's rules of survival. After being freed, gains increased ATK.
enemy_1116_liprr_2.lore: An inmate deeply familiar with the laws of survival of Mansfield State Prison. Will utilize his accumulated experience to outsmart you and is difficult to deal with.

abilities.text: Starts imprisoned. When imprisoned, ASPD is reduced
Freed after a few attacks, gaining increased ATK

enemy_1117_liiprr.description: An inmate equipped with a self-made ranged weapon. After being freed, attacks deal Arts damage; Prioritizes attacking Imprisonment Devices.
enemy_1117_liiprr.lore: An inmate who cobbled together a ranged weapon to avoid getting into brawls. Knows a little about Originium Arts and can strengthen his 'arrows'.

abilities.text: Starts imprisoned. When imprisoned, ASPD is reduced
Freed after a few attacks, gaining increased ATK and now deals Arts damage
Prioritizes attacking Imprisonment Devices

enemy_1117_liiprr_2.description: An inmate who proficiently uses a self-made ranged weapon. After being freed, attacks deal Arts damage; Prioritizes attacking Imprisonment Devices.
enemy_1117_liiprr_2.lore: An inmate experienced at using handmade ranged weapons. Though far from a master in Originium Arts, his arrows are already extremely dangerous.

abilities.text: Starts imprisoned. When imprisoned, ASPD is reduced
Freed after a few attacks, gaining increased ATK and now deals Arts damage
Prioritizes attacking Imprisonment Devices

enemy_1122_sphond.description: A beastly Ink Spirit with a bad temper, likes to eat apricots.
enemy_1122_sphond.lore: A beastly Ink Spirit named by the painter herself. It has a bad temper and likes to eat apricots. It follows its master's wishes and frolics about in the painting scroll, occasionally taking a bite out of it.

enemy_1122_sphond_2.description: A beastly Ink Spirit with a bad temper, likes to eat apricots.
enemy_1122_sphond_2.lore: A beastly Ink Spirit named by the painter herself. It has an even worse temper and doesn't want to eat apricots anymore. It follows its master's wishes and frolics about in the painting scroll, occasionally taking a bite out of it.

enemy_1123_spsbr.description: A common Ink Spirit. Apparently some kind of communal organism, it gets lonely when left by itself.
enemy_1123_spsbr.lore: A common Ink Spirit named by the painter herself. It's very smart and actually understands human speech. Apparently some kind of communal organism, it gets lonely when left by itself. It has done many a mean thing out of amusement for it's just an Ink Spirit, no matter how smart.

enemy_1123_spsbr_2.description: A common Ink Spirit. Apparently some kind of communal organism, it gets lonely when left by itself.
enemy_1123_spsbr_2.lore: A common Ink Spirit named by the painter herself. It's very smart and actually understands human speech. Apparently some kind of communal organism, it gets lonely when left by itself. Now it's actually getting down to business like a real Ink Spirit.

enemy_1124_spbow.description: A crafty Ink Spirit. Very proud of itself and its tricks, will prioritize attacking opposite attribute enemies.
enemy_1124_spbow.lore: A crafty Ink Spirit named by the painter herself. Very proud of itself and its tricks. Not above letting its allies charge straight into traps before betraying them. It will prioritize attacking opposite attribute enemies.

abilities.text: Prioritize attacking opposite attribute enemies

enemy_1124_spbow_2.description: A crafty Ink Spirit. Very proud of itself and its tricks, will prioritize attacking opposite attribute enemies.
enemy_1124_spbow_2.lore: A crafty Ink Spirit named by the painter herself. Very proud of itself and its tricks. Instinctively suppresses its enemies by attacking their weak spots for damage. It will prioritize attacking opposite attribute enemies.

abilities.text: Prioritize attacking opposite attribute enemies

enemy_1126_spslme.description: Can only be blocked by units of the same attribute. Explodes upon being defeated, touching an opposite attribute ally will trigger a more violent explosion.
enemy_1126_spslme.lore: A strange Ink Spirit named by the painter herself. Seems to be alive. Very lively with its movements and likes to wander around. Not very commonly seen as it explodes if it touches any fellow Ink Spirits with opposite attributes.

abilities.text: Can only be blocked by player's units of the same attribute.
Explodes upon death, dealing Arts damage to friendly units. Causes even greater damage if similar units of the opposite attribute are in its vicinity

enemy_1126_spslme_2.description: Can only be blocked by units of the same attribute. Explodes upon being defeated, touching an opposite attribute ally will trigger a more violent explosion.
enemy_1126_spslme_2.lore: A strange Ink Spirit named by the painter herself. Seems to be alive. Very lively with its movements and likes to wander around. It explodes if it touches any fellow Ink Spirits with opposite attributes, so any survivors tend to be even more powerful.

abilities.text: Can only be blocked by player's units of the same attribute.
Explodes upon death, dealing Arts damage to friendly units. Causes even greater damage if similar units of the opposite attribute are in its vicinity

enemy_1130_infstr.description: Splits into 2 Originiutant Excrescence upon death
enemy_1130_infstr.lore: A corpse being controlled by a parasitic Originiutant Excrescence.

abilities.text: Splits into 2 Originiutant Excrescences upon death

enemy_1131_sbeast.description: Splits into 2 Originiutant Excrescence upon death
enemy_1131_sbeast.lore: A sand beast infected by an Originiutant. Sand beasts are a species of small-sized omnivores that primarily inhabit deserts and hamadas. They are nocturnal in nature and are often tamed by the local Sargonians to be used as hunting beasts.

abilities.text: Splits into 2 Originiutant Excrescences upon death

enemy_1131_sbeast_2.description: Splits into 2 Originiutant Tumor upon death
enemy_1131_sbeast_2.lore: A sand beast infected and severely mutated by an Originiutant. Sand beasts are a species of small-sized omnivores that primarily inhabit deserts and hamadas. They are nocturnal in nature and are often tamed by the local Sargonians to be used as hunting beasts.

abilities.text: Splits into 2 Originiutant Tumors upon death

enemy_1132_sarchn.description: Splits into 3 Originiutant Excrescence upon death
enemy_1132_sarchn.lore: A rock spider infected by an Originiutant. Due to their similar appearances, rock spiders are often mistakenly believed to be a close relative of Infused Originium Slugs. However, the latest research shows that they are two completely different species.

abilities.text: Splits into 3 Originiutant Excrescences upon death

enemy_1132_sarchn_2.description: Splits into 3 Originiutant Tumor upon death
enemy_1132_sarchn_2.lore: A rock spider infected and severely mutated by an Originiutant. Due to their similar appearances, rock spiders are often mistakenly believed to be a close relative of Infused Originium Slugs. However, the latest research shows that they are two completely different species.

abilities.text: Splits into 3 Originiutant Tumors upon death

enemy_1137_plasm.description: A twisted organism born under the combined effects of radiation mutation and Originium infection.
enemy_1137_plasm.lore: A twisted organism born under the combined effects of radiation mutation and Originium infection.

abilities.text: Drains 1 Life Point when entering the Objective Point

enemy_1138_tumor.description: A twisted organism born under the combined effects of radiation mutation and Originium infection. When blocked, significantly reduces the blocker's ASPD
enemy_1138_tumor.lore: A twisted organism born under the combined effects of radiation mutation and Originium infection. The malign tumors on these organisms' bodies still contain a large amount of hazardous substances.

abilities.text: Drains 1 Life Point when entering the Objective Point
When blocked, significantly reduces the blocker's ASPD

enemy_1139_hologc.description: Tactical Originium Equipment developed by a certain Columbian tech company. Unable to move
enemy_1139_hologc.lore: Tactical Originium Equipment developed by a certain Columbian tech company. Generates a realistic holographic projection to obstruct enemies.

abilities.text: Unable to move

enemy_1139_hologc_2.description: The newest model of Tactical Originium Equipment developed by a certain Columbian tech company. Unable to move
enemy_1139_hologc_2.lore: The newest model of Tactical Originium Equipment developed by a certain Columbian tech company. Generates a realistic holographic projection to obstruct enemies.

abilities.text: Unable to move

enemy_1140_merhd.description: An infected creature controlled by a Caster. Widely used by mercenaries, has very fast movement speed.
enemy_1140_merhd.lore: An infected creature controlled by a Caster. Hounds are widely used by mercenaries, though some Perros object to it.

enemy_1140_merhd_2.description: Has even stronger combat capabilities than Tactical Hounds, has very fast movement speed.
enemy_1140_merhd_2.lore: An infected creature controlled by a Caster. Having gone through rigorous training, they now pose a much greater threat. Hounds are widely used by mercenaries, though some Perros object to it.

enemy_1141_merbow.description: A mercenary using ranged weaponry. Uses ranged attacks and calls for the offensive Air Support Drone 'Scrap' to bombard the target.
enemy_1141_merbow.lore: A mercenary using ranged weaponry. Uses a crossbow in battle and calls for the offensive Air Support Drone 'Scrap' to carry out aerial bombardment.

abilities.text: Before the first attack, calls for Scrap to support the battle from the Mobile Tactical Hangar

enemy_1141_merbow_2.description: A mercenary using ranged weaponry. Uses ranged attacks and calls for the advanced offensive Air Support Drone 'Scrap Model-U' to bombard the target.
enemy_1141_merbow_2.lore: A mercenary using ranged weaponry. Uses a crossbow in battle and calls for the more powerful offensive Air Support Drone 'Scrap Model-U' to carry out aerial bombardment.

abilities.text: Before the first attack, calls for Scrap Model-U to support the battle from the Mobile Tactical Hangar

enemy_1143_merrpg.description: A mercenary specializing in anti-armor combat. After firing a single-use super long-ranged grenade, charges at high speed.
enemy_1143_merrpg.lore: A mercenary specializing in anti-armor combat. Carries a single-use grenade launcher which is discarded after firing along with other non-essential equipment, after which they charge at high speed towards the enemy.

abilities.text: Can fire a super long-range grenade, dealing AoE Physical damage
After firing, significantly increases Movement Speed and can only perform melee attacks

enemy_1143_merrpg_2.description: A mercenary specializing in anti-armor combat. After firing a powerful single-use super long-ranged grenade, charges at high speed.
enemy_1143_merrpg_2.lore: A mercenary specializing in anti-armor combat. Carries a powerful single-use grenade launcher which is discarded after firing along with other non-essential equipment, after which they charge at high speed towards the enemy.

abilities.text: Can fire a super long-range grenade, dealing AoE Physical damage

abilities.text: Initially has 100% Physical Dodge for a period of time

abilities.text: Upon dropping below half HP for the first time, gains 100% Physical Dodge for a period of time

enemy_1260_durmag_2.lore: A Durin who has made a career out of designing sandcastles. Having accepted the reality that it is impossible to actually build a sandcastle, he has not even been drafting designs recently, instead focusing his efforts on tinkering with the Arts Unit.

abilities.text: Gains increased ATK with each attack (up to a limit); when affected by certain Negative Statuses, these stacks will be lost

abilities.text: Gains increased ATK with each attack (up to a limit); when affected by certain Negative Statuses, these stacks will be lost

abilities.text: Increases Blood Debt by a miniscule amount when defeated

abilities.text: While under the Asset Liquidation status, attacks are converted into Arts damage

Increases Blood Debt when defeated

enemy_1288_duskls_2.lore: A elite Dublinn soldier fused with their Leader's ember. Chasing their Leader's ember even more fervently, their bodies are manipulated by Arts to ceaselessly rise from the dead.

abilities.text: Attacks deal additional Burn while near burning Reeds
When defeated, turns into an Invisible Ember of Fury that must be damaged 5 times to defeat; respawns after a period of time

abilities.text: Attacks ignite Reeds beneath the target
When defeated, deals Arts damage to all nearby friendly units and ignites all Reeds

enemy_1303_mhshep.description: An herbivore common to the mountains. Starts battle Resting. After being attacked, it and all surrounding hornbeasts become Combat-Ready.
enemy_1303_mhshep.lore: An herbivore that moves in herds, common to the mountains. Docile creatures, they hide from predators using the mock-vegetation wool on their backs, but that's no reason to underestimate their pointed horns.

abilities.text: Starts battle Resting. After being attacked, it and all surrounding hornbeasts become Combat-Ready

enemy_1303_mhshep_2.description: An herbivore common to the mountains. Starts battle Resting. After being attacked, it and all surrounding Hardy Hornbeasts become Combat-Ready.
enemy_1303_mhshep_2.lore: A variety of hornbeast which startles into a frenzy at the drop of a hat. They attack viciously, throwing their sharp horns against anything nearby without the slightest warning. Given how often they concuss themselves, scholars are extremely confused as to how they haven't gone extinct yet.

abilities.text: Starts battle Resting. After being attacked, it and all surrounding hornbeasts become Combat-Ready

enemy_1304_mhwolf.description: A carnivore common to the mountains. Prioritizes attacking Hornbeasts.
enemy_1304_mhwolf.lore: A carnivore common to the mountains that hunts primarily in packs. Bearing developed mandibles, they crush their prey's skulls with ease. Most fond of feeding on hornbeast stragglers.

abilities.text: Prioritizes attacking Hornbeasts and Hardy Hornbeasts

enemy_1304_mhwolf_2.description: A carnivore common to the mountains. Prioritizes attacking Hardy Hornbeasts.
enemy_1304_mhwolf_2.lore: An Oxmane subspecies particular to certain regions. Perennial contention with large prey has led their teeth to grow sharp, sinking fast and firm into the fleshy parts of their quarry. Undeterred by their companions dying to their prey's retaliation, they will launch attacks again and again.

abilities.text: Prioritizes attacking Hornbeasts and Hardy Hornbeasts

enemy_1305_mhslim.description: A wild infected creature that sprays superheated fluids at its foes. Attacks deal Arts damage and Burn.
enemy_1305_mhslim.lore: A wild infected creature, they spray superheated fluids at their foes, posing more of a threat than typical Originium Slugs. Abundant in environments with abnormal energy, their breeding and migration patterns remain a mystery.

abilities.text: Attacks deal Burn

enemy_1305_mhslim_2.description: A wild infected creature that sprays superheated fluids at its foes. Attacks deal Arts damage and Burn.
enemy_1305_mhslim_2.lore: A wild infected creature, the final stages of infection having led them to burn even hotter. Their fluids, hot as magma, melt even their own bodies. Once cooled, beautiful patterns can be found in the pools they leave behind.

abilities.text: Attacks deal Burn

enemy_1306_mhtrtl.description: It grows a rear shell hard enough to withstand falling stones, but bears an unusually soft belly. Weak spot located on its front, damage dealt to the rear significantly decreased.
enemy_1306_mhtrtl.lore: An herbivore that dwells by cliffsides, their front claws equipped for digging out rock faces. They grow rear shells hard enough to withstand falling stones, but bear unusually soft bellies. Their delicious meat is the primary cause of their falling population.

abilities.text: Weak spot located on its front, damage dealt to the rear is significantly decreased

enemy_1306_mhtrtl_2.description: Its sturdy shell can shrug off severe batterings. Weak spot located on its front, damage dealt to the rear significantly decreased.
enemy_1306_mhtrtl_2.lore: A Chitotex Clawbeast subspecies particular to certain regions. Their sturdy upper limbs accelerate their excavation of rock exponentially, while their stern shells can shrug off severe batterings. These traits allow them to better expand their territory.

abilities.text: Weak spot located on its front, damage dealt to the rear is significantly decreased

enemy_1307_mhrhcr.description: Covers its crown in protective boulders. Weak spot located on its rear, damage dealt to the front significantly decreased.
enemy_1307_mhrhcr.lore: An herbivore that dwells by cliffsides. The protective boulders that crown their heads are, in fact, the secretions of a symbiotic organism. Some have witnessed Basorobeasts battling Chitotex Clawbeasts in turf wars.

abilities.text: Weak spot located on its rear, damage dealt to the front is significantly decreased

enemy_1307_mhrhcr_2.description: A regimen since infancy has honed its head to exceptional sturdiness. Weak spot located on its rear, damage dealt to the front significantly decreased.
enemy_1307_mhrhcr_2.lore: A Basorobeast subspecies particular to certain regions. Regimens of knocking into cliff rock since infancy have honed their heads to exceptional sturdiness, able to shrug off fierce frontal attacks. Survival never ends, and the struggle never ceases.

abilities.text: Weak spot located on its rear, damage dealt to the front is significantly decreased

enemy_1308_mheagl.description: A large and violent fowlbeast. Occasionally flings dead Oxmanes, dealing Physical Damage.
enemy_1308_mheagl.lore: A large and violent fowlbeast, it shoots sharp pennaceous feathers from the air to drive prey out of hiding, then uses strong claws to finish targets off once they're on their last legs. Liable to use prey clutched in its claws as an additional weapon against intruders in its territory.

abilities.text: Occasionally flings dead Oxmanes, dealing heavy Physical damage

enemy_1308_mheagl_2.description: A Serrant Fowlbeast subspecies particular to certain regions. Occasionally flings dead Oxmanes, dealing Physical Damage.
enemy_1308_mheagl_2.lore: A Serrant Fowlbeast subspecies particular to certain regions. Stronger pectoral muscles increase its flight capabilities, rendering it capable of launching torrential offensives from high elevation. It makes a renewed territorial bid, this time on the entire sky.

abilities.text: Occasionally flings dead Oxmanes, dealing heavy Physical damage

enemy_1313_wdfmr.description: Friendly Unit. Once their identity is confirmed, raises your cost limit after retreating to the Protection Objective
enemy_1313_wdfmr.lore: Ordinary folk scattered throughout Norport Borough. Abandoned by Londinium and subjected to the Sarkaz's high-handed blockade, these orphans have become the ones most deeply affected by the haze of war.

abilities.text: Friendly Unit
Once their identity is confirmed, restores your max DP after retreating to the Objective Point

enemy_1313_wdfmr.debut: Episode 12: All Quiet Under the Thunder

enemy_1313_wdfmr_2.description: Friendly Unit. Once their identity is confirmed, raises your cost limit after retreating to the Protection Objective
enemy_1313_wdfmr_2.lore: Military spies disguised as civilians in Norport Borough, lacking the communication channels to pass on their abundant intel. They were already helping their Dukes learn about their rivals before the borough broke off from Londinium, and have seamlessly transitioned to spying on the Sarkaz Army's movements after the Military Commission seized control.

abilities.text: Friendly Unit
Once their identity is confirmed, restores your max DP after retreating to the Objective Point

enemy_1313_wdfmr_2.debut: Episode 12: All Quiet Under the Thunder

enemy_1314_wdnjd.description: Spy. When their identity is revealed, the next attack's ATK is greatly increased
enemy_1314_wdnjd.lore: A spy hired by a mysterious employer to monitor their rivals while disguised as civilians. Most are amateurs at gathering intelligence, and their impulsiveness and unorthodox practices often expose the secrets they think they're keeping safe.

abilities.text: Spy
When their identity is revealed, the next attack's ATK is greatly increased

enemy_1314_wdnjd.debut: Episode 12: All Quiet Under the Thunder

enemy_1314_wdnjd_2.description: Spy. When their identity is revealed, the next attack's ATK is greatly increased
enemy_1314_wdnjd_2.lore: A spy hired by a mysterious employer to monitor their rivals while disguised as civilians. These seasoned operatives will occasionally employ less orthodox methods to get their more impatient rivals to let down their guard.

abilities.text: Spy
When their identity is revealed, the next attack's ATK is greatly increased

enemy_1314_wdnjd_2.debut: Episode 12: All Quiet Under the Thunder

enemy_1315_wdyjd.description: Spy. When their identity is revealed, becomes invisible
enemy_1315_wdyjd.lore: A spy hired by a mysterious employer to monitor their rivals while disguised as civilians. They have obviously undergone professional intelligence training, and the complexity of the blockade taught them even more about carefully observing their environment.

abilities.text: Spy
When their identity is revealed, becomes Invisible

enemy_1315_wdyjd.debut: Episode 12: All Quiet Under the Thunder

enemy_1315_wdyjd_2.description: Spy. When their identity is revealed, becomes invisible
enemy_1315_wdyjd_2.lore: A spy hired by a mysterious employer to monitor their rivals while disguised as civilians. They know the blockade inside-out, and prefer to first gather enough crucial information before proceeding to the next step of their plans.

abilities.text: Spy
When their identity is revealed, becomes Invisible

enemy_1315_wdyjd_2.debut: Episode 12: All Quiet Under the Thunder

enemy_1317_wdexg.description: Attacks reduce cost when carrying ammo. Ammo capacity: 3
enemy_1317_wdexg.lore: Operatives attached to the Military Commission, specializing in gathering intelligence and softening the enemy frontlines. The actual leaders of this unit are a mystery, and are surprisingly always the first to show up wherever the Military Commission is operating.

abilities.text: Attacks reduce DP when carrying ammo. Ammo capacity: 3

enemy_1317_wdexg.debut: Episode 12: All Quiet Under the Thunder

enemy_1317_wdexg_2.description: Attacks reduce cost when carrying ammo. Ammo capacity: 3
enemy_1317_wdexg_2.lore: Operatives attached to the Military Commission, primarily tasked with assassinating high-value targets. When on a mission, they often arrive before their subordinates to soften the enemy frontlines with incredible speed, while simultaneously planning their next action.

abilities.text: Attacks reduce DP when carrying ammo. Ammo capacity: 3

enemy_1317_wdexg_2.debut: Episode 12: All Quiet Under the Thunder

enemy_1318_wdsmgc.description: When HP is below half, creates a clone at their location
enemy_1318_wdsmgc.lore: A product of the cooperation between the Damazti Cluster and the Military Commission. Under the guidance of the Damazti Cluster, these extraordinarily gifted Sarkaz have learned to split themselves in two with Arts. However, every split places a heavy burden on the caster's body, and each imperfect replica merely makes them an easier target on the battlefield.

abilities.text: When HP is below half, creates a Virtual Image at their location

enemy_1318_wdsmgc.debut: Episode 12: All Quiet Under the Thunder

enemy_1318_wdsmgc_2.description: When HP is below half, creates a clone at their location
enemy_1318_wdsmgc_2.lore: A product of the cooperation between the Damazti Cluster and the Military Commission, able to effortlessly split themselves in two with Arts. They can easily adapt their imperfect replicas to draw the enemy's attention and give themselves an advantage.

abilities.text: When HP is below half, creates a Virtual Image at their location

enemy_1318_wdsmgc_2.debut: Episode 12: All Quiet Under the Thunder

enemy_1325_cbgpro.description: Military hounds that first saw action in Bolívar.
enemy_1325_cbgpro.lore: Military hounds that first saw action in Bolívar. Their claws and fangs are as vicious as their temperament.

enemy_1325_cbgpro_2.description: Carefully picked military hounds that chase their quarry to the bitter end.
enemy_1325_cbgpro_2.lore: Carefully picked military hounds that chase their quarry to the bitter end.

enemy_1326_cbagen.description: When attacking, temporarily reduces your Operators' Block by 1; if Operator is on a Gravity Switch, reduces their Block to 0
enemy_1326_cbagen.lore: Columbian soldiers stationed in Trimounts. They have close ties to all the tech companies and first dibs on cutting-edge equipment.

abilities.text: Attacks temporarily inflict -1 Block to allied Operators
If Operator is on a Gravity Switch, reduces their Block to 0

enemy_1326_cbagen_2.description: When attacking, temporarily reduces your Operators' Block by 1; if Operator is on a Gravity Switch, reduces their Block to 0
enemy_1326_cbagen_2.lore: Columbian soldiers stationed in Trimounts. They have a good understanding of all the tech companies and will choose to fight with their favorite corporation's equipment.

abilities.text: Attacks temporarily inflict -1 Block to allied Operators
If Operator is on a Gravity Switch, reduces their Block to 0

enemy_1327_cbrokt.description: If Movement Speed is higher than starting speed, gains Low-Altitude Hovering and takes off!
enemy_1327_cbrokt.lore: Soldiers from the experimental unit born of the 'Horizon Arc Project,' able to fly at low altitudes with their jet propulsion equipment.

abilities.text: If Movement Speed is higher than starting speed, gains Low-Altitude Hovering and takes off!

enemy_1327_cbrokt_2.description: If Movement Speed is higher than starting speed, gains Low-Altitude Hovering and takes off!
enemy_1327_cbrokt_2.lore: Soldiers from the experimental unit born of the 'Horizon Arc Project,' skilled at flying with their jet propulsion equipment. They enjoy the feeling of defying gravity.

abilities.text: If Movement Speed is higher than starting speed, gains Low-Altitude Hovering and takes off!

enemy_1329_cbshld.description: Starting DEF and RES are high, but reduced whenever damage is taken
enemy_1329_cbshld.lore: Soldiers from an experimental unit with formidable defenses using the most advanced alloy technologies. However, the unresolved instability of the material makes them better suited for short, high-pressure skirmishes than drawn-out battles.

abilities.text: Starting DEF and RES are high, but reduced whenever damage is taken

enemy_1329_cbshld_2.description: Starting DEF and RES are high, but reduced whenever damage is taken
enemy_1329_cbshld_2.lore: Soldiers from an experimental unit with formidable defenses using the most advanced alloy technologies. They don't even need their equipment to hold the frontline and prevent the enemy's advance.

abilities.text: Starting DEF and RES are high, but reduced whenever damage is taken

enemy_1335_bldrat.description: Inflicts Bleed on allied Operators after several attacks.
enemy_1335_bldrat.lore: An Infected Creature that appears in dark places. It has a high reproductive capacity, and can be commonly found everywhere. The endless usage of its host's food stocks makes it an unwelcome houseguest.

abilities.text: Inflicts Bleed on allied Operators after several attacks

enemy_1335_bldrat_2.description: Inflicts Bleed on allied Operators after several attacks.
enemy_1335_bldrat_2.lore: An Infected Creature that appears in dark places. It has a high reproductive capacity, and is commonly found everywhere. It's currently starving! Be careful, hungry creatures tend to be more violent!

abilities.text: Inflicts Bleed on allied Operators after several attacks

enemy_1336_bldbat.description: Attacks deal Arts Damage and inflict Bleed on allied Operators after several attacks.
enemy_1336_bldbat.lore: An Infected Creature that appears in dark places, often found in deep caves and abandoned buildings. It is easily startled, and will not hesitate to attack intruders who enter its territory.

abilities.text: Aerial unit, prioritizes attacking Holy Statue
Deals Arts damage
Inflicts Bleed on allied Operators after several attacks

enemy_1336_bldbat_2.description: Attacks deal Arts Damage and inflict Bleed on allied Operators after several attacks.
enemy_1336_bldbat_2.lore: A startled Vesperwing will attack intruders who enter its territory at any cost. Their claws and fangs are sharp, and they are both ferocious and impatient. But in their eyes, they're simply protecting their homeland.

abilities.text: Aerial unit, prioritizes attacking Holy Statue
Deals Arts damage
Inflicts Bleed on allied Operators after several attacks

enemy_1337_bhrknf.lore: A member of a bandit gang operating in the wastelands using stolen weapons. They are not soldiers, and lack professional training, so stealing goods is more important to them than anything else.

abilities.text: Can appear in the battlefield
Prioritizes attacking Holy Statue
Steals 1 DP from allied Operators after several attacks

enemy_1337_bhrknf_2.lore: An elite member of a bandit gang operating in the wastelands using stolen weapons. Now leading a small group of subordinates, they have kept their plundering habits and are even greedier than their henchmen.

abilities.text: Can appear in the battlefield
Prioritizes attacking Holy Statue
Steals 1 DP from allied Operators after several attacks

enemy_1338_bhrjst.description: Invisible, natural DP regeneration rate is reduced by 25% when on the field
enemy_1338_bhrjst.lore: A member of a bandit gang operating in the wastelands, sneakily operating in the shadows. They habitually speak in half-truths, and many of them used to moonlight as pickpockets before they drifted into the wastes.

abilities.text: Can appear in the battlefield
Invisible
When on the field, natural DP regeneration rate is reduced

enemy_1338_bhrjst_2.description: Invisible, natural DP regeneration rate is reduced by 50% when on the field
enemy_1338_bhrjst_2.lore: An elite member of a bandit gang operating in the wastelands, sneakily operating in the shadows. Some claim to have complicated pasts, but the truth of it is irrelevant: their skillsets are now used only for survival.

abilities.text: Can appear in the battlefield
Invisible
When on the field, natural DP regeneration rate is reduced

enemy_1339_bhrgrd.description: Steals 3 DP and recovers 5% HP after several attacks
enemy_1339_bhrgrd.lore: A member of a bandit gang operating in the wastelands, equipped with the best gear the bandits can get their hands on. When life became unsustainable, some gave in to their desperation, becoming ferocious outlaws roaming the wastes.

abilities.text: Can appear in the battlefield
After several attacks, steals 3 DP and recovers a certain amount of HP

enemy_1339_bhrgrd_2.description: Steals 3 DP and recovers 10% HP after several attacks
enemy_1339_bhrgrd_2.lore: An elite member of a bandit gang operating in the wastelands, equipped with the best gear the bandits can get their hands on. The most vicious plunderers are completely indifferent to the suffering of others, having long forgotten that they were once just the most desperate of civilians.

abilities.text: Can appear in the battlefield
After several attacks, steals 3 DP and recovers a certain amount of HP

enemy_3005_lpeopl.description: Stays on the field and does not move towards the Objective Point, and will not be attacked by enemies, but will lose HP after becoming Terrified; Depletes 1 Life Point on death; Does not count towards the defeated enemies counter.
enemy_3005_lpeopl.lore: A civilian sheltering in the monastery, treating the place as home. Simple and feeble, yet they strive to live. Yearning for spiritual sustenance, they pursue their faith, but are easily provoked into rushing around blindly.

abilities.text: Stays on the field and does not move towards the Objective Point
Panic level continuously increases in battle
Becomes Terrified when Panic level is full, and will continuously lose HP
Will deplete a Life Point upon dying; Does not count towards the defeated enemies counter

enemy_1344_ddlamb.description: Leaves Carmine Steam at its location when defeated
enemy_1344_ddlamb.lore: A fluffy critter that has found something nice on the street, and wants to play with whoever it bumps into. Even though you can't make out its expression from its obscured face, you can sense it in its revelry.

abilities.text: Leaves Carmine Steam at its location when defeated

enemy_1344_ddlamb.debut: So Long, Adele: Home Away From Home

enemy_1344_ddlamb_2.description: Leaves Carmine Steam at its location when defeated

abilities.text: Leaves Carmine Steam at its location when defeated

enemy_1344_ddlamb_2.debut: So Long, Adele: Home Away From Home

enemy_1345_tplamb.description: Leaves Carmine Steam at its location when defeated

abilities.text: Leaves Carmine Steam at its location when defeated

enemy_1345_tplamb.debut: So Long, Adele: Home Away From Home

abilities.text: Leaves Carmine Steam at its location when defeated

enemy_1345_tplamb_2.debut: So Long, Adele: Home Away From Home

enemy_1346_ynshp.lore: A fluffy critter that has found something nice from the surfskate shop, so fast that it comes and goes without a trace! It's practicing its acceleration and turning for the upcoming 'Lava Surfing Championships.'

abilities.text: Invisible

abilities.text: Invisible
Can stack with a Hot Spring 'Jolly Rascal' and leaves Carmine Steam on tiles it travels over after combining

enemy_1360_dfello.description: Attacks deal Arts damage and restore HP; turns into Blood Amber when defeated
enemy_1360_dfello.lore: A creation of the Sanguine Court's Originium Arts. It is said that just a few drops of fresh blood can spawn an entire swarm of these mindless worms. Once they've latched on, they will never let go until their hunger and thirst have been sated.
