enemy_1361_dthrow.lore: A long-range bombardier of the Sarkaz Royal Court that has received the blessing of the Sanguinarch of Vampires. Wherever they aim will be left a sea of flames, and their targets inevitably reduced to rubble.

abilities.text: Deals long-ranged attacks that explode after a delay, inflicting Physical damage in an area.
Will be reborn as a Touch of the Sanguinarch after falling in battle for the first time

enemy_1361_dthrow.debut: Episode 13: The Whirlpool that is Passion

enemy_1361_dthrow_2.description: An elite long-ranged bombardier of the Sarkaz Royal Court that attacks with more powerful ammunition that explodes after a delay, dealing AOE Physical damage. Will be reborn as a Touch of Benevolence upon being defeated for the first time.
enemy_1361_dthrow_2.lore: An elite long-range bombardier of the Sarkaz Royal Court that has received the blessing of the Sanguinarch of Vampires. They do not aim at any particular target or tangible enemy. The only thing reflected in their eyes is ruination itself.

abilities.text: Deals long-ranged attacks that explode after a delay, inflicting Physical damage in an area.
Will be reborn as a Touch of Benevolence after falling in battle for the first time

enemy_1361_dthrow_2.debut: Episode 13: The Whirlpool that is Passion

enemy_1365_spnwiz.description: A Sarkaz Caster responsible for protecting the Feranmut's skeleton, capable of hiding within turbulences in spacetime. When defeated within range of a Bloodcalling Altar, will return to the field when affected by the altar's Pulse Wave.
enemy_1365_spnwiz.lore: A Sarkaz Caster responsible for guarding the Feranmut's skeleton, their nature warped due to perpetually drifting through spacetime along with it. In times of emergency, they will call upon the Feranmut's power to disappear from the enemy's sight before reappearing at a more opportune time.

abilities.text: If defeated within range of a Bloodcalling Altar, slips into a turbulence in spacetime and cannot be attacked during this period.
Will revive on the field when affected by an altar's pulse.

enemy_1365_spnwiz.debut: Episode 13: The Whirlpool that is Passion

enemy_1365_spnwiz_2.description: A Sarkaz Caster captain responsible for protecting the Feranmut's skeleton, capable of hiding within turbulences in spacetime. When defeated within range of a Bloodcalling Altar, will return to the field when affected by the altar's Pulse Wave.
enemy_1365_spnwiz_2.lore: A Sarkaz Caster responsible for guarding the Feranmut's skeleton, their nature warped due to perpetually drifting through spacetime along with it, to the point that their very existence has become tenuous. abilities.text: If defeated within range of a Bloodcalling Altar, slips into a turbulence in spacetime and cannot be attacked during this period.
Will revive on the field when affected by an altar's pulse.

enemy_1365_spnwiz_2.debut: Episode 13: The Whirlpool that is Passion

enemy_1367_dseed.description: Blood essence, highly-condensed into an adamant form. When affected by the pulse of a Bloodcalling Altar, will be reborn at the altar as a Bloodborn Spawn.
enemy_1367_dseed.lore: The blood that flows from warriors under the gaze of the Sanguinarch of Vampires will be turned into beautiful crystals waiting to be used once more, waiting to savor the taste of despair once more.

abilities.text: When affected by the pulse of a Bloodcalling Altar, will be reborn as a Bloodborn Spawn at the altar.

enemy_1367_dseed.debut: Episode 13: The Whirlpool that is Passion

enemy_1369_bmbcar1.lore: A bomb whose explosion can suppress the effects of Sarkaz witchcraft, with a prototype delivery platform originating from Victoria. After being modified by a certain demolition expert, it has become a trump card in our desperate battles.

Explodes upon reaching a Bloodcalling Altar, dealing a large amount of True damage to surrounding enemies and destroying the Altar.

enemy_1369_bmbcar1.debut: Episode 13: The Whirlpool that is Passion

abilities.text: Launches a Straight Shot when positioned in a straight line with an allied unit: fires 3 bolts in the target's direction

abilities.text: Invisible

abilities.text: Takes root and becomes Thicket when on a Meadow

enemy_10073_mpcar.description: Maintenance Helper whose pathfinding module has been disrupted by Originium. The meal delivery function added by the Engineering Department no longer works.
enemy_10073_mpcar.lore: Maintenance Helper whose pathfinding module has been disrupted by Originium. The meal delivery function added by the Engineering Department no longer works. 'You want a repair function? Look, we've already got plenty of engineers. As for Warfarin's food safety warning, we're working on it.'

enemy_10073_mpcar_2.description: Maintenance Helper whose IFF module has been disrupted by Originium. The drill added by the Engineering Department is now much more dangerous.
enemy_10073_mpcar_2.lore: Maintenance Helper whose IFF module has been disrupted by Originium. The drill carefully added by the Engineering Department with a safety clutch is now much more dangerous. 'Power output? Look, our priorities are providing our operators with a safe working environment and sufficient moral support, not making this thing do complex work.'

enemy_10074_mpcata.description: Cold drink machine that has had its trajectory computing module disrupted by Originium. It uncontrollably launches frozen beverage cans at operators who aren't even thirsty at all.
enemy_10074_mpcata.lore: Cold drink machine that has had its trajectory computing module disrupted by Originium. It uncontrollably launches frozen beverage cans at operators who aren't even thirsty at all. Prize winner of the Engineering Department's 10th Ignoble Prize awards. No one can refuse a thoughtful fridge that automatically launches refreshing drinks at you while you work, after all. Just don't think too much about what the medics would say at your next checkup.

enemy_10074_mpcata_2.description: Hot drink machine that has had its temperature control module disrupted by Originium. The super-heated drinks it delivers bring physical and psychological trauma.
enemy_10074_mpcata_2.lore: Hot drink machine that has had its temperature control module disrupted by Originium. The super-heated drinks it delivers bring physical and psychological trauma. Prize winner of the Engineering Department's 10th Ignoble Prize awards, though it will not be long before the complaints overflow the department's inbox.

abilities.text: Flying unit.
Self-destructs immediately when there is an Operator nearby, dealing a large amount of Arts damage to surrounding units

enemy_10083_hlbird.description: Gains Fear for several seconds when its HP drops below 50% for the first time

abilities.text: Flying unit.

abilities.text: When outside the Filming Area, attacks inflict Nervous Impairment

enemy_10094_crstf_2.description: When outside the Filming Area, attacks inflict Nervous Impairment

abilities.text: When outside the Filming Area, attacks inflict Nervous Impairment

abilities.text: Can only be blocked by allied units inside the Filming Area

enemy_10095_crgst_2.lore: An extra holding a clapperboard and pretending to be part of the crew. He is not chasing a dream, just doing it for fun. He likes to hear the audience's screams, caring little about what he is doing in front of the camera.

abilities.text: Can only be blocked by allied units inside the Filming Area

enemy_10096_crprp.lore: The lighting props are too heavy for even this strong Forte prop technician, who has been crushed by the weight of stress and responsibility. He eagerly seeks any opportunity to take a break.

abilities.text: Places a Lighting Prop on the first empty ground tile within the Filming Area that it passes through

enemy_10096_crprp_2.description: Places a Lighting Prop on arriving at an empty ground tile in the Filming Area
enemy_10096_crprp_2.lore: It is not rest but attention that this strong Forte prop technician needs. Everything he does in front of the camera catches people's eyes.

abilities.text: Places a Lighting Prop on the first empty ground tile within the Filming Area that it passes through

enemy_10111_ymgpck.description: The size of a fingertip, the weight of a murmur of fate and inertia.
enemy_10111_ymgpck.lore: The size of a fingertip, the weight of a murmur of fate and inertia. It does not intend to destroy, not even to arrive. It only follows the shortest path of inevitability and the longest path of coincidence, spinning and moving forward. In its own time, the world is simply walls to collide with, propositions to bounce off, cacophonous and silent.

abilities.text: Gain 'Favor' when it collides with an enemy
Disappears when it stops moving
Disappears after a while

enemy_10112_ymgds_2.lore: A veteran Kinsekikai underling who has fallen many times and gotten back up, but still cannot help but philosophize about his own existence and if he is suited to this line of work. That is why he remains an underling, despite his experience.

abilities.text: Becomes temporarily stunned when shifted

enemy_10113_ymgung.description: Briefly takes off when colliding with 'Certain Fates', blocked, or encountering a Hole.

abilities.text: Briefly takes off when colliding with 'Certain Fates', blocked, or encountering a Hole.

enemy_10113_ymgung_2.description: Briefly takes off when colliding with 'Certain Fates', blocked, or encountering a Hole.

abilities.text: Briefly takes off when colliding with 'Certain Fates', blocked, or encountering a Hole.

abilities.text: When on the battlefield, has Invisibility and disguises as a Hole
Becomes hostile after losing Invisibility or absorbing 'Certain Fates'
Permanently loses Invisibility when becoming hostile

enemy_10117_ymggld.description: Continuously accelerates, taking off after reaching a certain speed.
enemy_10117_ymggld.lore: A fast ninja who is able to take flight briefly. A visiting Columbian delegate looked at him suspiciously for a long time.

abilities.text: Continuously accelerates, taking off after reaching a certain speed.

enemy_10117_ymggld_2.description: Continuously accelerates, taking off after reaching a certain speed.
enemy_10117_ymggld_2.lore: A very fast ninja who is able to glide longer. Ancient techniques meet the latest technology.

abilities.text: Continuously accelerates, taking off after reaching a certain speed.

enemy_10103_mjcppp.lore: Tooth-shaped object in a dream, a manifestation of the wish to eat sweets to one's heart's delight without fear of cavities. That is why they would rather stay forever in a fairy tale than wake up.

abilities.text: Attacks inflict Nervous Impairment.
Once awakened, gains increased Movement Speed and loses damage reduction effect

abilities.text: Continuously inflates a balloon in place of attacking; when balloon is full, gains Barrier and Low-Altitude Hovering

enemy_10104_mjcbln_2.description: Continuously inflates a balloon in place of attacking; when balloon is full, gains Barrier and Low-Altitude Hovering

abilities.text: Continuously inflates a balloon in place of attacking; when balloon is full, gains Barrier and Low-Altitude Hovering
Loses Low-Altitude Hovering when Barrier is lost

abilities.text: Attacks inflict Nervous Impairment.
Once awakened, gains increased Movement Speed, loses damage reduction effect, and temporarily increases ATK for all awakened Clockwork Servants

abilities.text: Seeks out and attacks Operators who block the moonlight

enemy_10120_uaghst_2.lore: Members of the Ursus Phantom Infiltrator Squad. Equipped with advanced stealth gear, they are tasked with performing the decapitation strike when battle begins.

abilities.text: Cannot be blocked.

enemy_2068_skzirn.description: Unblockable. Movement Speed gradually increases. Deals Physical damage to all units upon entering the Objective.
enemy_2068_skzirn.lore: Automaton protecting the Holy City. It can execute its built-in sacrificial ritual to unleash a powerful holy shockwave, commonly known by some Sarkaz as 'self-destruction.'

abilities.text: Cannot be blocked.
Movement Speed gradually increases. Deals Physical damage to all units upon entering the Objective.

enemy_2093_skzams.description: The only way to the end.
enemy_2093_skzams.lore: The only way to the end.

abilities.text: Drops a random Collectible when it enters the Protection Objective; Remaining HP carries over to the next operation

enemy_2101_dyspll.description: Talisman paper frequently seen in the Garden of Grotesqueries. Likes to stick to people. Destroyed after taking a certain number of attacks.
enemy_2101_dyspll.lore: Paper talisman seen throughout the Garden of Grotesqueries, with various messages written on them: Timetables, notes, tips, prohibitions... Endowed with meaning by the hand of man, it stubbornly refuses to leave anyone that it sticks to.

abilities.text: Destroyed after taking a certain number of attacks
When attached to a target, deals Arts damage every second and prevents them from using skills

enemy_2102_dytmbr.description: A character often seen in Yanese shadow plays. Absorbs a nearby Talisman to heal when HP is low.
enemy_2102_dytmbr.lore: A character often seen in Yanese shadow plays, prone to strange encounters in those plays. This Shadowgeist has seen these scenes play out so many times that it believes them to be real, and even warning of the talismans is not enough to dissuade it.

abilities.text: When HP drops below a certain level, absorbs a nearby Talisman and recovers HP

enemy_2103_dykens.description: Once a medicine bottle, now a geist. Carries 3 Talismans.
enemy_2103_dykens.lore: Once a wandering physician's medicine bottle, it provided healing to many warriors. When it became a geist, it was moved by a talisman and put the talisman in its bottle, embarking on a journey of chivalry.

abilities.text: Starts with 3 Talismans; attacks attach a Talisman to the target when carrying a Talisman

enemy_2104_dycast.description: A well-polished mirror that likes to give others unsolicited advice using talismans.
enemy_2104_dycast.lore: A well-polished mirror that believes it sees everything clearly. When it became a Geist, it was not content with just seeing things, but could not stop itself from giving unsolicited advice, just like the old scholars in the Tianshi Bureau.

abilities.text: Picks a target from very long range, dealing Arts damage and sending a Talisman

enemy_2122_dybgzd.description: Created by Yi to handle various mundane matters, so that he may live in seclusion without being interrupted by official matters.
enemy_2122_dybgzd.lore: Created by Yi to handle various mundane matters, so that he may live in seclusion without being interrupted by official matters.

abilities.text: Explodes upon death, dealing Arts damage to friendly units. Causes even greater damage and stuns friendly units if similar units of the opposite attribute are in its vicinity
Destroyed after taking a certain number of attacks

enemy_4002_syokai.description: Cheap goods sold for scrap from the Kazimierz arenas. Feel free to waste it however you like.
enemy_4002_syokai.lore: Cheap goods sold for scrap from the Kazimierz arenas. Feel free to waste it however you like.

abilities.text: Flying unit.

enemy_4002_syokai_2.description: Cheap goods sold for scrap from the Kazimierz arenas. Feel free to waste it however you like.
enemy_4002_syokai_2.lore: Cheap goods sold for scrap from the Kazimierz arenas. Closure has performed some slight modifications on this batch, but it won't change the fact these are cheap as hell.

abilities.text: Flying unit.
When destroyed, grants a deployable unit
Does not count towards the defeated enemies counter

enemy_4003_pbank.description: An experimental prototype developed during the early years of a certain Columbian tech company. When destroyed, recovers the SP of nearby Operators.
enemy_4003_pbank.lore: An experimental prototype developed during the early years of a certain Columbian tech company. The objective was to provide power on the battlefield, however due to the lack of a positioning device, it will often leave by itself if unattended to.

abilities.text: Cannot be blocked.
When destroyed, recovers the SP of nearby Operators
Does not count towards the defeated enemies counter

enemy_4004_muvltr.description: Unblockable. Periodically drops soda bottles that explode after some time.
enemy_4004_muvltr.lore: Logistics would soon realize that Engineering's latest supply wagon is a little too... eccentric to transport soda bottles. It has been repurposed to toss exploding soda bottles on the racecourse.

abilities.text: Cannot be blocked.
Throws exploding soda bottles, dealing True damage around itself (including to itself).

enemy_4004_muvltr_2.description: Unblockable. Periodically drops soda bottles that explode after some time.
enemy_4004_muvltr_2.lore: Logistics has realized that Engineering's latest supply wagon is a little too... eccentric to transport soda bottles. It has been repurposed to toss exploding soda bottles on the racecourse, an explosive race the likes of which has never been seen.

abilities.text: Cannot be blocked.
Throws exploding soda bottles, dealing True damage around itself (including to itself).

enemy_4005_musqrl.description: Chance to drop its Supply Box when taking damage. HP depletes rapidly without its Supply Box.
enemy_4005_musqrl.lore: The Musbeast Supplier likes to carry an oversized supply box on one paw as it scurries around the racecourse. It does so because it thinks it's super strong, and because it can do this, it believes it's super strong.

abilities.text: Chance to drop its supply box when taking damage.
HP depletes over time when it loses its supply box.

enemy_4005_musqrl_2.description: Small chance to drop its Supply Box when taking damage. HP depletes rapidly without its Supply Box.
enemy_4005_musqrl_2.lore: The Musbeast Supplier likes to carry an oversized supply box on one paw and flex its biceps as it scurries around the racecourse. It does so because it thinks it's super strong, and because it can do this, it believes it's super strong.

abilities.text: Chance to drop its supply box when taking damage.
HP depletes over time when it loses its supply box.

enemy_4006_mumole.description: Unblockable. Restores the HP of other surrounding enemies after taking a certain amount of damage.
enemy_4006_mumole.lore: Logistics belatedly realized that sighting one sandbeast often means the presence of a dozen. They have been trained to serve as suppliers now, but there is always the risk of tripping over the supplies they scatter all over the place.

abilities.text: Restores a large amount of HP to all nearby enemies but itself when it takes a certain amount of damage.

enemy_4006_mumole_2.description: Unblockable. Restores the HP of other surrounding enemies after taking a certain amount of damage.
enemy_4006_mumole_2.lore: Logistics belatedly realized that sighting one sandbeast often means the presence of a dozen. They have been trained to serve as suppliers now, but the medical room is filled with competitors who tripped over the supplies they scattered all over the place.

abilities.text: Restores a large amount of HP to all nearby enemies but itself when it takes a certain amount of damage.

enemy_4007_murino.description: Always faces the side where you have the most units. Damage from the front is greatly reduced.
enemy_4007_murino.lore: No one understands the danger of the Rhodes Island arena better than a Burdenbeast Supplier. When it saw a ball hit by an Operator's claymore smash through the arena's wall, it couldn't help but cry out, 'Moo, moo!'

abilities.text: Damage from the front is greatly reduced.
Always faces the side where you have more units.

enemy_4007_murino_2.description: Always faces the side where you have the most units. Damage from the front is greatly reduced.
enemy_4007_murino_2.lore: No one understands the danger of the Rhodes Island arena better than a Burdenbeast Supplier. When it saw a ball hit by an Operator's claymore smash through the arena's wall, it's urgent moos must have meant, 'Please save me, God of Burdenbeasts!'

abilities.text: Damage from the front is greatly reduced.
Always faces the side where you have more units.

enemy_4008_mucat.description: After 5 attacks without defeating a unit, stops moving and takes significantly more damage for 5s.
enemy_4008_mucat.lore: It is unusual, but not unheard of, to be injured when an arena cleaning cart runs over your toes. Things become somewhat surreal when there's an adorable beast on the cart eager to whoop you with a squeaky hammer.

abilities.text: Performs 5 heavy blows with greatly increased ATK. An attack that defeats a unit does not use up a count.
When out of attack counts, cannot attack and takes significantly more damage for some time.

enemy_4008_mucat_2.description: After 5 attacks without defeating a unit, stops moving and takes significantly more damage for 5s.
enemy_4008_mucat_2.lore: It is unusual, but not unheard of, to be injured when an arena cleaning cart runs over your toes. Things become somewhat scary when there's an adorable beast on the cart trying to whoop you for no reason with a squeaky hammer.

abilities.text: Performs 5 heavy blows with greatly increased ATK. An attack that defeats a unit does not use up a count.
When out of attack counts, cannot attack and takes significantly more damage for some time.

enemy_4009_murgby.description: Deals additional damage to Foldable Bastion.
enemy_4009_murgby.lore: The Ironhead Forward is known for his headdown tackles, headlong rushes, and headstrong nature.

abilities.text: Deals more damage to [Foldable Bastion].

enemy_4009_murgby_2.description: Deals additional damage to Foldable Bastion.
enemy_4009_murgby_2.lore: The Ironhead Forward has his own motto: Find a heading, and head there headfirst.

abilities.text: Deals more damage to [Foldable Bastion].

enemy_4010_mubsbl.description: Prioritizes attacking Foldable Bastion and deals additional damage.
enemy_4010_mubsbl.lore: A once-in-a-generation pitcher who was born to throw. Ordinary ballgames have lost their appeal; he prefers the thrill of throwing at people.

abilities.text: Deals more damage to [Foldable Bastion].
Prioritizes attacking units on [Foldable Bastions].
Cannot be blocked.

enemy_4010_mubsbl_2.description: Prioritizes attacking Foldable Bastion and deals additional damage.
enemy_4010_mubsbl_2.lore: A once-in-a-generation pitcher who was born to throw. His grandfather once served in Gaul's grenadier battalion, so it's no wonder that he enjoys throwing at people.

abilities.text: Deals more damage to [Foldable Bastion].
Prioritizes attacking units on [Foldable Bastions].
Cannot be blocked.

enemy_4012_mumssi.description: If it can leap high, it can kick a ball very, very far away.
enemy_4012_mumssi.lore: This musbeast was recruited as shooter under the reasoning that if it can leap high, it can kick a ball very, very far away.

abilities.text: Prioritizes attacking the football towards your goal.

enemy_4012_mumssi_2.description: If it can leap high, it can kick a ball very, very far away.
enemy_4012_mumssi_2.lore: This musbeast was recruited as shooter under the reasoning that if it can leap high, it can kick a ball very, very far away. I mean really far away.

abilities.text: Prioritizes attacking the football towards your goal.

enemy_4013_mubufn.description: Its head is so big that it can block the goal just by standing there.
enemy_4013_mubufn.lore: This burdenbeast was recruited as goalkeeper under the reasoning that its head is so big that it can block the goal just by standing there.

abilities.text: Prioritizes attacking the football towards your goal.

enemy_4013_mubufn_2.description: Its head is so big that it can block the goal just by standing there.
enemy_4013_mubufn_2.lore: This burdenbeast was recruited as goalkeeper under the reasoning that its head is so big that it can block the goal just by standing there. There is even the off-chance that it catches the ball between its horns.

abilities.text: Prioritizes attacking the football towards your goal.

enemy_4014_mugnfu.description: Can't lose if the opponent has no players left.
enemy_4014_mugnfu.lore: Can't lose if the opponent has no players left. If one swing doesn't do it, swing again.

abilities.text: Prioritizes attacking your Operators.

enemy_4014_mugnfu_2.description: Can't lose if the opponent has no players left.
enemy_4014_mugnfu_2.lore: Can't lose if the opponent has no players left. If one swing doesn't... Nah, one swing always does it.

abilities.text: Prioritizes attacking your Operators.

enemy_4015_musucr.description: Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.
enemy_4015_musucr.lore: A football that imitates RMA70 minerals to enrich the match experience. Its spikes are surprisingly benign. Players who have tried it say that kicking it is a highly interactive experience.

abilities.text: A standard football.
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

enemy_4016_mubuln.description: Very light and easy to move. Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.
enemy_4016_mubuln.lore: A football that imitates a furry critter to enrich the match experience... Hey, where did it go? Okay, it's actually a real furry critter that's drifting through the air right now.

abilities.text: A very light football that can be easily moved.
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

enemy_4017_muinbl.description: Heavy and hard to move. Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.
enemy_4017_muinbl.lore: A football made from compressed building materials to enrich the match experience. 'Heavy' doesn't begin to describe it. Do your foot a favor and don't bother kicking it.

abilities.text: A heavy football that is hard to move.
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

enemy_4018_muboom.description: Chance to explode when kicked. Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.
enemy_4018_muboom.lore: A football that imitates infused... Hey, why is it moving? Okay, it's actually a genuine infused Originium slug. Genuinely explosive, too!

abilities.text: Chance to explode when kicked, stunning and damaging nearby units.
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

enemy_4019_mugold.description: Gives 3x score. Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.
enemy_4019_mugold.lore: A football that looks like Originite Prime to enrich the match experience. Not actual Originium, so it is perfectly safe and does not explode.

abilities.text: Gives 3x score.
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

enemy_4020_muboun.description: Bouncy. Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.
enemy_4020_muboun.lore: A football inspired by an extremely unstable entity to enrich the match experience. It is as unpredictable as its inspiration, and has already been bouncing all over the field for half an hour... Somebody stop it, please!

abilities.text: A very bouncy football.
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

enemy_4022_mushtm.description: Shoots quicker, and always aims at unblocked goals
enemy_4022_mushtm.lore: The Tactical Team is known for its tactical acumen and superb tactical equipment. Tactical Team Shooters equipped with thermal-imaging goggles can shoot with unerring accuracy in any condition, which is why they prefer to play in fog.

abilities.text: Shoots quicker and aims in a direction where there are no Positional Barriers

enemy_4022_mushtm_2.description: Shoots quicker, and always aims at unblocked goals
enemy_4022_mushtm_2.lore: Elite members of the Tactical Team are said to have been baptized by fire in battle. Elite Tactical Team Shooters equipped with thermal-imaging goggles can shoot with unerring accuracy in any condition, which is why they prefer to play in fog.

abilities.text: Shoots quicker and aims in a direction where there are no Positional Barriers

abilities.text: Kickoffs are more powerful and aims in a direction where there are no Positional Barriers

enemy_4024_mushtg_2.lore: Elite members of the Tactical Team are said to have been baptized by fire in battle. Elite Tactical Team Hitters equipped with vital monitors and warning systems can quickly locate opposing players attempting to hurt their teammates. Watch out—they have already found you.

abilities.text: Prioritizes searching for your units that dealt damage to opposing players

enemy_4025_muhrym.description: Dribbles for a period of time after touching the ball
enemy_4025_muhrym.lore: Members of the Ball Mania Club have such love for football that they have taken to the field dressed up as one. Ball is love, ball is life.

enemy_4025_muhrym_2.lore: Honorary members of the Ball Mania Club are one with the ball, physically and spiritually. Ball is love, ball is life.

enemy_4026_muhryb.lore: Members of the Ball Mania Club have such love for football that they have taken to the field dressed up as one. These goalies are so attuned to the ball that their passes never miss their mark.

enemy_4031_muftsn.lore: An Originium beetle plays the part of the football. It sucks in air to expand rapidly when it feels threatened, but this one seems to have a leak and keeps getting flatter as it rolls.

Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

enemy_4032_muftmg.description: Gets bigger and heavier as it is kicked
enemy_4032_muftmg.lore: An Originium beetle plays the part of the football. It sucks in air to expand rapidly when it feels threatened, to scare away predators, but this just makes it all the more adorable to those present.

abilities.text: Becomes bigger when kicked, requiring more damage to move
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

enemy_4033_muftic.description: Leaves behind slippery ice on the ground
enemy_4033_muftic.lore: A ball made in the image of the indomitable will of the north. Like its inspiration, its mere presence summons snow and ice. Anyone up for a game of ice hockey?

abilities.text: Leaves behind slippery ice on the ground
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

enemy_4034_muftgl.description: Leaves behind sticky slime on the ground
enemy_4034_muftgl.lore: A ball made in the image of a strange sea creature. Like its inspiration, it excretes a mucous slime, but it is unable to slide smoothly. Instead, it gets stuck in its own slime all the time.

abilities.text: Leaves behind sticky slime on the ground
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

enemy_4040_mugoal.lore: The ending point of Obstacle Drift. The signal tower in the middle sends out the signal announcing the end of the match as soon as the Drifter touches the buoy.

abilities.text: Flying unit.
Shoot it down to earn a small amount of points

enemy_4042_murdr.description: Shoot it down to earn a moderate amount of points

abilities.text: Flying unit.
Shoot it down to earn a moderate amount of points

abilities.text: Flying unit.
Shoot it down to earn a large amount of points!

Gives a large amount of points if not destroyed after being attached to the Drifter!

abilities.text: Gains Invisibility while in water

enemy_4047_mustak.lore: A buoy set up on the Obstacle Drift course. The brazier is not firmly fastened. It is doubtful that you will ever be able to find the safety official responsible for these buoys.

abilities.text: Deals Physical damage to Basic Floater, Gravity Floater, and Supplies Floater

enemy_4048_mubarn.description: A cragpincer that feels the need to strengthen its limbs, but something is not quite right with its training, resulting in one limb being significantly larger than the other.
enemy_4048_mubarn.lore: A cragpincer that feels the need to strengthen its limbs, but something is not quite right with its training, resulting in one limb being significantly larger than the other.

enemy_4048_mubarn_2.description: A cragpincer that feels the need to strengthen its limbs. Amongst its kind, the size of one's limb has become a status symbol.
enemy_4048_mubarn_2.lore: A cragpincer that feels the need to strengthen its limbs. Amongst its kind, the size of one's limb has become a status symbol.

enemy_6006_fystone.description: Part of the Spherical Colossus, it has no sentience but it is very heavy. Latching on to an operator makes them unable to take action.
enemy_6006_fystone.lore: Part of the Spherical Colossus, it has no sentience but is very heavy. Don't let it latch on to an Operator.

abilities.text: Latches onto an operator, preventing the operator from attacking or using skills
Gradually loses HP

enemy_6008_mtslms.description: A native shelled Originium slug. Very high DEF.

enemy_6012_plants.lore: A symbiont that appears alongside 'Nature's Compromise.' It is difficult to distinguish whether they are biological descendants or Originium Slugs contaminated and assimilated by the pollen. Perhaps a combination of both?

enemy_6017_icdrone.description: A drone originally used to deliver ice cream to remote regions, but after going rogue it now sells to the masses.
enemy_6017_icdrone.lore: A drone originally used to deliver ice cream to remote regions, but after going rogue it now sells to the masses. It has embraced its desire to deliver sweetness everywhere, and insists on submerging everyone in sugar.

abilities.text: Flying unit.
Sends a Supersweetie Superblend to the Deployment Waiting Zone upon death

enemy_6019_escort.description: Every 3rd attack stuns your Operators for 6 sec.
enemy_6019_escort.lore: Agriculture drone equipped with a variety of tools for seeding, watering, fertilizing, etc. It is proud of its role, and of its natural fertilizer fermentation system. 'No one can refuse some steaming hot fertilizer.'

abilities.text: Every 3rd attack Stuns your Operators for several seconds

enemy_6021_cask.description: More likely to be attacked. Gives you a 'Long Live Mead!' when defeated.
enemy_6021_cask.lore: Mead that has been aged for more than a decade, with a strong flowery scent. The Liquor Association stole it to deal a blow to the Mead Association, an attempt that resulted in some of its members turning traitor, leading to turmoil within. It has now become a weapon of revenge for the Liquor Association.

abilities.text: More likely to be attacked, causes the target Operator to be Stunned while on the battlefield; added to the Deployment Waiting Zone as Long Live Mead! when defeated

enemy_6024_crnbug.description: So unruly, it wants to squeeze into your mouth. Causes 'Bottomless Pit' to malfunction when loaded into it.
enemy_6024_crnbug.lore: So unruly, it wants to squeeze into your mouth.

abilities.text: Dies when loaded by 'Greedy Catcher.'

enemy_6026_techn.description: Stone orbs created by an Altar of Hatred. Upon destruction, deals True damage and stuns all allied units in the surrounding area.
enemy_6026_techn.lore: Stone spheres created by the Altar of Hatred. Sarkaz witchcraft has given them 'life,' yet they seek out the living so that they might perish together.

abilities.text: Upon destruction, deals True damage and stuns all allied units in the surrounding area.

enemy_6030_frgzac.description: A fragment of the body of 'Aubade'. Its mind is hazy like that of a newborn foal, yearning to return to its 'mother'.
enemy_6030_frgzac.lore: A fragment of the body of 'Aubade'. Its mind is hazy like that of a newborn foal, yearning to return to its 'mother'.

abilities.text: Cannot be blocked.
Must be damaged 25 times to defeat
After coming into contact with 'Aubade', disappears and restores the HP of 'Aubade' by a certain amount
When defeated, reduces the number of 'Twitter' that 'Aubade' can split into

enemy_6031_visfrg.description: A fragment of the pedestal of 'Aubade'. It drifts like feathers, repelling enemies that attempt to obstruct 'Twitter'.
enemy_6031_visfrg.lore: A fragment of the pedestal of 'Aubade'. It drifts like feathers, repelling enemies that attempt to obstruct 'Twitter'.

abilities.text: More likely to be attacked, and causes the target Operator to be Stunned while on the battlefield; provides 10 Transfer Permits when defeated
Must be damaged 30 times to defeat

enemy_7001_blwzad.description: Attacks cause the target to receive 50% of this unit's ATK as Arts damage per second over 10 seconds (stacks)
enemy_7001_blwzad.lore: An apprentice caster who has learned some of the ancient Arts of their tribe. Although not yet proficient with Arts, it is enough to fight whoever they disagree with.

abilities.text: Attacks cause the target to receive a certain amount of this unit's ATK as Arts damage per second over a few seconds (stacks)

enemy_7001_blwzad_2.description: Attacks cause the target to receive 50% of this unit's ATK as Arts damage per second over 10 seconds (stacks)
enemy_7001_blwzad_2.lore: An elite caster under a Lord Ameer, able to employ a kind of ancient Arts to cast menacing attacks, nicknamed a 'curse' by the locals.

abilities.text: Attacks cause the target to receive a certain amount of this unit's ATK as Arts damage per second over a few seconds (stacks)

enemy_7002_veingd.description: More likely to be attacked by friendly units; when attacked, inflicts 200 Arts damage to the attacker
enemy_7002_veingd.lore: A deformed Infected Creature often found wandering around ore veins, stubbornly thinking they have a duty to guard the mine.

abilities.text: More likely to be attacked by friendly units; when attacked, inflicts a certain amount of Arts damage to the attacker

enemy_7002_veingd_2.description: More likely to be attacked by friendly units; when attacked, inflicts 200 Arts damage to the attacker
enemy_7002_veingd_2.lore: A deformed Infected Creature often found wandering around ore veins. Guarding the mines has become an obsession of theirs, and they are willing to die for it.

abilities.text: More likely to be attacked by friendly units; when attacked, inflicts a certain amount of Arts damage to the attacker

enemy_7003_catapt.description: Prioritizes attacking constructs; when attacking constructs, ATK increases to 150%
enemy_7003_catapt.lore: A contraption that hurls fruit with rock-hard shells instead of boulders, destroying all constructs in its detection range by targeting their weak points. The designer must surely have been an expert in architecture.

abilities.text: Prioritizes attacking constructs; when attacking constructs, gains greatly increased ATK

enemy_7003_catapt_2.description: Prioritizes attacking constructs; when attacking constructs, ATK increases to 180%
enemy_7003_catapt_2.lore: A contraption that hurls fruit with rock-hard shells instead of boulders, destroying all constructs in its detection range by targeting their weak points. After some upgrades, it is powerful enough to destroy large buildings.

abilities.text: Prioritizes attacking constructs; when attacking constructs, gains greatly increased ATK

enemy_7004_xbdeer.description: Does not attack; after being attacked, runs away a random distance and rests for a period of time.
enemy_7004_xbdeer.lore: A herbivorous beast commonly found almost anywhere in the wild. It has small but sharp horns and is not aggressive, but will run and jump to avoid attacks when frightened. The meat is very tender.

abilities.text: After being attacked, runs away a random distance and rests for a period of time

enemy_7004_xbdeer_2.description: Does not attack; after being attacked, runs away a random distance and rests for a period of time.
enemy_7004_xbdeer_2.lore: A herbivorous beast commonly found almost anywhere in the wild. It has grown large horns, but will still run away on reflex, jumping even higher and faster. The meat is very tender.

abilities.text: After being attacked, runs away a random distance and rests for a period of time

enemy_7005_xbbull.description: Normally does not attack, but will counter when attacked. Gradually restores HP over time.
enemy_7005_xbbull.lore: A beast with moss growing on its back, appearing round and gentle but it is actually fierce with a terrible temper. The moss on its body has a hemostatic effect, and it will eat it when injured.

abilities.text: Normally does not attack, but counters when attacked
Gradually restores HP over time

enemy_7005_xbbull_2.description: Normally does not attack, but will counter when attacked. Gradually restores HP over time.
enemy_7005_xbbull_2.lore: A beast with moss all over its body, easily agitated compared to others of its kind because of tiny, hard-to-remove bugs hiding in its vegetation. The moss grows back extremely quickly, and it will sometimes eat some even when uninjured.

abilities.text: Normally does not attack, but counters when attacked
Gradually restores HP over time

enemy_7006_xbcrab.description: Normally does not attack, but counters when attacked.
enemy_7006_xbcrab.lore: A crab-like creature with rocks on its shell that it uses to camouflage itself. Extremely tenacious, it can sometimes be found far from sources of water. A distant relative of Metal Crabs, but its meat is delicious.

abilities.text: Normally does not attack, but counters when attacked

enemy_7006_xbcrab_2.description: Normally does not attack, but counters when attacked.
enemy_7006_xbcrab_2.lore: A Cragpincer with crystals on its shell, not only eye-catching but also extremely beautiful. However, it is also harder to handle. The completely crystallized carapace is a popular ornament once properly processed. It is said that some people also keep these as ornamental pets.

abilities.text: Normally does not attack, but counters when attacked

enemy_7016_shushu.description: When other Barrenlands Musbeasts are nearby, ATK increases (stacks)
enemy_7016_shushu.lore: A musbeast commonly found in the barrens. Though not particularly aggressive by nature, they become a bottomless pit of ruined foodstuffs when in groups.

abilities.text: When other Barrenlands Musbeasts are nearby, ATK increases (stacks)

enemy_7017_miner.description: Deals more damage when attacking resources
enemy_7017_miner.lore: A familiar sight in mine shafts for millennia. Laborers have always propped up the pinnacles of civilization with their rugged hands, but found their own feet mired in the mud of the label 'uncivilized.'

abilities.text: Deals more damage when attacking resources

enemy_7018_scarab.description: Cannot be blocked by Operators or Summons; explodes when Blocked and deals great AoE damage
enemy_7018_scarab.lore: The name of this Originium Slug may actually be a misnomer, as the volatile part is actually the 'harvest' between its legs. When asked about this, its namers claimed that these creatures were too fast to be closely observed.

abilities.text: Cannot be blocked by Operators or Summons; explodes when Blocked and deals great AoE damage

enemy_7021_xbmoth.description: Upon taking damage, becomes Invulnerable and cannot move for a period of time
enemy_7021_xbmoth.lore: A small creature that can only be seen far from nomadic cities. With a flutter of its wings, it escapes once more into the shadows.

abilities.text: Upon taking damage, becomes Invulnerable and cannot move for a period of time

enemy_7023_gatbb.description: When unblocked, damage taken is reduced by 50%
enemy_7023_gatbb.lore: An acolyte whose charm reflects her power. The more delicate her flowers, the swifter her blade.

abilities.text: When unblocked, damage taken is reduced by 50%

enemy_7025_clbb.description: Attacks deal Burn, and recovers HP every second
enemy_7025_clbb.lore: The young apprentices who follow behind the Wandering Troubadours are not yet proficient at controlling flames, but can already perform the critical job of moving the oil cannisters.

abilities.text: Attacks deal Burn, and recovers HP every second
Become Silenced during the Wet Season or when Frozen

enemy_7034_xbmsn.description: Moves at regular speed only when in visible range
enemy_7034_xbmsn.lore: Laborers such as these can be seen everywhere across the barrens. Their diligence is their greatest virtue.

abilities.text: Moves at regular speed only when in visible range

enemy_7044_xblbug.description: When in Low-Altitude Hovering state, cannot be blocked and can only be targeted by anti-air attacks. Loses Low-Altitude Hovering after being inflicted with Stun or Sleep
enemy_7044_xblbug.lore: Wild and infected, it can glide a short distance on the wind with its small wings, enough to fly over obstacles and evade capture.

abilities.text: Low-Altitude Hovering

enemy_5504_arcslmi.description: An inconspicuous creature; Does not appear to increase stage points in SUPER HOOK
enemy_5504_arcslmi.lore: A character from the game SUPER HOOK. It was split from Jelly Kid and follows its lead in scrubbing the floor.

abilities.text: High Movement Speed
Does not increase stage points in SUPER HOOK

enemy_5505_arctxi.description: Accumulates stage points when moving. Points are added to total score when it reaches the gray Objective Point. Loses some points when attacked.
enemy_5505_arctxi.lore: A character from the game HURDLE SPEEDER, a ship-car that sails the land. Elaborate and flimsy, its precious yet fragile value can only be expressed through continuous journey.

abilities.text: Upon colliding with an enemy unit, inflicts Physical damage that ignores Dodge and inflicts a brief Stun
Can collect Washed-Up Parts to improve performance

enemy_5506_arcgo.description: Gives the Ship-Car buffs as it passes through
enemy_5506_arcgo.lore: A character from the game HURDLE SPEEDER, an ordinary bottle that was not fitted with the wheels necessary to become a ship-car. Contains useful components that may improve a ship-car's performance.

abilities.text: Disappears when 'The Amphibian' Ship-Car passes through, increasing its performance based on component form
Treasure Rudder
Doubles 'The Amphibian' Ship-Car's current points
Warding Waves
'The Amphibian' Ship-Car becomes Invisible
Twin Cutlasses
Increases 'The Amphibian' Ship-Car's ATK significantly

enemy_5507_arctolm.description: Gains extra points when passing through tiles with Pure White Steam
enemy_5507_arctolm.lore: A character from the game FOUNTAIN WAR. Furry creature that escaped from Fashion Street. Dolly wants it to come back? Who cares? Playing with Pure White Steam is more important!

abilities.text: Permanently Invulnerable
Gains extra points when passing through Pure White Steam

enemy_18001_lhship.description: Provides resources and equipment based on distance moved when it reaches its destination. Extra rewards after reaching a certain distance.
enemy_18001_lhship.lore: Boat that distributes resources through the waterways, painted with Rhodes Island's colors. As the concept of 'landship' is deconstructed, transportation becomes more localized, belonging to the roads and rivers.

abilities.text: Unblockable; can be attacked by enemies
Grants rewards when arriving at its destination, and extra rewards for long distance traveled

enemy_18002_lhbetl.description: When defeated, all Pincerbugs gain increased ATK for the rest of the operation
enemy_18002_lhbetl.lore: A sociable creature which releases special pheromones upon death, drawing its own kind and increasing their aggression. The pincer on its head is not just used for fighting, but also for communicating, sensing the environment, and determining status. A popular pet due to its cuteness.

abilities.text: When defeated, all Pincerbugs gain increased ATK for the rest of the operation

enemy_9023_acdums.description: Deals Arts damage and inflicts Necrosis on its surroundings when attacked; changes form after being attacked a certain number of times
enemy_9023_acdums.lore: A lingering beat, a dull echo. Who conducts it, and why does it sing?

abilities.text: Must be attacked several times to defeat
Can only be blocked by units with at least 2 Block
[Polytonality]: Switches between [Golden Wail] and [Penumbral Lament] forms
ASPD increased in [Golden Wail] form, transforms into [Penumbral Lament] form after taking damage several times
Movement Speed is reduced while ATK is increased in [Penumbral Lament] form, transforms into [Golden Wail] form after taking damage several times
Upon taking damage, deals Arts damage in an area around itself, inflicting Necrosis
All 'Echoes' periodically play in ensemble, dealing AoE Arts damage and inflicting Necrosis
